----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- COMPLETIONIST - QUEST DESCRIPTIONS
-- File: Completionist_Translations_D.txt   (quest names are in Completionist_Translations_N.txt)
--
-- Each line is:   KEY <TAB> | description
--
-- HOW TO TRANSLATE
--   * Change only the text AFTER the '|'. Never change the KEY in front of it.
--   * Keep the TAB between the KEY and the '|': a key ends at its first TAB.
--   * '\n' is a line break. Keep each one where it is.
--   * Translate the labels too: Quest Giver, Location, Overview, Missable, NOTE.
--   * Lines starting with '-' are comments and are ignored.
--   * The order of the lines does not matter: lines are matched by KEY.
--   * Set your editor's tab width to 4 and the columns line up.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------

----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Main quest: Skyrim
----------------------------------------------------------------------------
MSQ_Quest00	|Quest Giver: - Automatic Start.\nOverview: - Use the Statue of Mara to start your new life.
MSQ_Quest01	|Quest Giver: - Automatic Start.\nOverview: - Start your new life in Skyrim.
MSQ_Quest02	|Quest Giver: - Starts automatically after character creation.\nLocation: - Helgen and Helgen Keep.\nOverview: - You wake on a cart as an Imperial prisoner heading to execution. When a dragon attacks Helgen, you choose to flee through the keep with either Ralof (Stormcloak) or Hadvar (Imperial), gathering basic gear on the way. The choice does not lock you out of any questline.
MSQ_Quest03	|Quest Giver: - Hadvar or Ralof.\nLocation: - Riverwood and Whiterun.\nOverview: - Warn Jarl Balgruuf in Dragonsreach that a dragon has attacked Helgen. Speaking to Alvor or Gerdur in Riverwood on the way is optional; you can go straight to Whiterun.
MSQ_Quest04	|Quest Giver: - Jarl Balgruuf the Greater.\nLocation: - Dragonsreach (Whiterun), Riverwood and Bleak Falls Barrow.\nOverview: - Farengar Secret-Fire wants a Dragonstone from Bleak Falls Barrow. Fight through the draugr, reach the word wall and return the stone to Farengar. The side quest The Golden Claw (Riverwood Trader) also leads to the barrow. Rewards a Word of Power and levelled armour.
MSQ_Quest05	|Quest Giver: - Starts automatically once you hand over the Dragonstone (Bleak Falls Barrow); Jarl Balgruuf and Irileth bring the news.\nLocation: - Dragonsreach and the Western Watchtower outside Whiterun.\nOverview: - A dragon has been sighted near Whiterun. Irileth takes you to Jarl Balgruuf, who sends you with reinforcements to the Western Watchtower. The dragon attacks there: kill it, absorb its soul to unlock Fus, then report back. Balgruuf rewards you with a weapon, makes you Thane of Whiterun, gives you Lydia as housecarl and becomes your friend, which lets Whiterun's steward sell you Breezehome.
MSQ_Quest06	|Quest Giver: - Jarl Balgruuf the Greater.\nLocation: - Ivarstead and High Hrothgar.\nOverview: - The Greybeards have summoned you with the Thu'um. Travel to Ivarstead, climb the 7,000 Steps to High Hrothgar and meet Arngeir and the other Greybeards, who teach you Words of Power for Unrelenting Force and Whirlwind Sprint.
MSQ_Quest07	|Quest Giver: - Arngeir.\nLocation: - High Hrothgar, Ustengrav and Riverwood.\nOverview: - The Greybeards' last trial is to fetch the Horn of Jurgen Windcaller from his tomb in Ustengrav. The horn is already gone, and a note sends you to Riverwood, where Delphine of the Sleeping Giant Inn has it. Return it to Arngeir to be formally recognised as Dragonborn and to learn the final word of Unrelenting Force. Ustengrav's word wall holds the other Words of Power.
MSQ_Quest08	|Quest Giver: - Delphine.\nLocation: - Sleeping Giant Inn (Riverwood) and the dragon burial mound near Kynesgrove.\nOverview: - Delphine wants proof that you are Dragonborn. She takes you to the burial site near Kynesgrove, where Alduin raises the dragon Sahloknir. Kill Sahloknir, absorb his soul and return to Delphine, who then starts to trust you.
MSQ_Quest09	|Quest Giver: - Delphine.\nLocation: - Riverwood, Solitude and the Thalmor Embassy.\nOverview: - Delphine needs Thalmor intelligence. Meet Malborn in the Winking Skeever, smuggle in whatever gear you want, and attend the embassy party in disguise. Slip away from the guests, search the ambassador's office and dungeon for the files, then escape through the trapdoor.
MSQ_Quest10	|Quest Giver: - Delphine.\nLocation: - Riften and the Ratway.\nOverview: - Delphine sends you to find Esbern, a Blades member hiding in Riften. Ask Brynjolf or Keerava where he is (persuade, bribe or brawl), search the Ratway to reach Esbern's hideout in the Ratway Warrens and bring him back to Delphine at the Sleeping Giant Inn.
MSQ_Quest11	|Quest Giver: - Esbern.\nLocation: - The Ratway, Riverwood and Sky Haven Temple.\nOverview: - Escort Esbern from the Ratway to Riverwood, then follow him to the Blades' lost fortress, Sky Haven Temple. Fight your way in and read Alduin's Wall to learn how Alduin was defeated before. A levelled Dragonbane katana lies in Sky Haven Temple (tiers at levels 1, 19, 27, 36 and 46), best at level 46+.\nMissable: - The Dragonbane's tier is decided when the temple first loads, so entering it early gives you a weaker one.
MSQ_Quest12	|Quest Giver: - Starts automatically after Alduin's Wall (Esbern sends you to the Greybeards).\nLocation: - High Hrothgar and the Throat of the World.\nOverview: - Alduin's Wall shows he was beaten by a Shout. Ask Arngeir to teach you Clear Skies and use it to open the path up the mountain. Meet Paarthurnax at the summit, learn a Word of Power from him, use Fire Breath on him and speak to him again. Rewards the Clear Skies shout and a Fire Breath word.
MSQ_Quest13	|Quest Giver: - Paarthurnax.\nLocation: - Throat of the World, High Hrothgar or Sky Haven Temple, Septimus Signus's Outpost, Alftand, Blackreach and the Tower of Mzark.\nOverview: - Paarthurnax says the ancient Nords used an Elder Scroll to cast Alduin forward in time. Learn where it is (you may ask Esbern or Arngeir, and Urag gro-Shub and Septimus Signus can help), then take the Elder Scroll from the Tower of Mzark in Blackreach, reached through Alftand.
MSQ_Quest14	|Quest Giver: - Starts automatically when you get the Elder Scroll.\nLocation: - Throat of the World.\nOverview: - Take the Elder Scroll to the Throat of the World and read it to open a time wound, where you learn the Dragonrend shout. Back in the present, use Dragonrend to bring Alduin down and drive him off. Rewards Dragonrend.
MSQ_Quest15	|Quest Giver: - Starts automatically after Alduin's Bane; speak to Paarthurnax, Arngeir or Esbern.\nLocation: - Throat of the World, High Hrothgar or Sky Haven Temple, and Dragonsreach (Whiterun).\nOverview: - To find where Alduin has gone, trap a dragon in Dragonsreach and question it. The Jarl of Whiterun will only help if the Civil War is paused (see Season Unending). Learn the Shout that calls Odahviing, call him, wear him down with the trap and interrogate him. Starting this quest also starts the Paarthurnax quest.
MSQ_Quest16	|Quest Giver: - Jarl Balgruuf the Greater (or Vignar Gray-Mane if Whiterun is Stormcloak).\nLocation: - Solitude, Windhelm and High Hrothgar.\nOverview: - The Jarl will only lend you Dragonsreach if the Civil War is paused. Persuade the Greybeards to host peace talks at High Hrothgar, bring both Tullius and Ulfric, and negotiate a truce, making choices about its terms. The terms can trade Markarth and Riften between the sides. Rewards the Call Dragon shout.\nMissable: - The talks are cancelled for good if the Civil War takes Hjaalmarch or Winterhold before the council has been held.
MSQ_Quest17	|Quest Giver: - Esbern or Delphine (it opens as soon as The Fallen starts).\nLocation: - Sky Haven Temple and the Throat of the World.\nOverview: - The Blades learn Paarthurnax was one of Alduin's chief allies and refuse to help until you kill him. Kill him, then tell Delphine.\nMissable: - Esbern and Delphine stop being friendly and you leave the Blades faction (Sky Haven Temple items count as stealing) until you kill him and report back. Killing him removes your High Hrothgar services and costs favour with Arngeir. You cannot keep both the Blades and the Greybeards.
MSQ_Quest18	|Quest Giver: - Odahviing.\nLocation: - Skuldafn (north-east Skyrim).\nOverview: - Free Odahviing, who tells you Alduin has fled through a portal in Skuldafn. Fly with him, fight through the temple and draugr and reach the portal to Sovngarde.
MSQ_Quest19	|Quest Giver: - Starts automatically on entering Sovngarde.\nLocation: - Sovngarde.\nOverview: - Walk the path through the mists, find out how to defeat Alduin and gain entry to the Hall of Valor, where you can speak to the heroes of Sovngarde.
MSQ_Quest20	|Quest Giver: - Hakon, Gormlaith and Felldir.\nLocation: - Hall of Valor, Sovngarde.\nOverview: - With the heroes of Sovngarde, shout away the mist protecting Alduin, then fight and defeat the World-Eater. Rewards the Call of Valor shout and ends the main questline.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Civil War
----------------------------------------------------------------------------
CWQuest00	|Quest Giver: - General Tullius and Legate Rikke in Castle Dour, Solitude (anyone you ask about the Legion points you there).\nLocation: - Castle Dour (Solitude) and Fort Hraggstad.\nOverview: - To prove yourself, clear the bandits out of Fort Hraggstad, report to Legate Rikke and take the Imperial Legion oath.\nMissable: - You can only follow one side of the Civil War: joining the Legion closes the Stormcloak questline.
CWQuest01	|Quest Giver: - Legate Rikke.\nLocation: - Castle Dour (Solitude) and Korvanjund.\nOverview: - Meet Rikke outside Korvanjund, fight past the Stormcloaks guarding it and through the draugr inside, open the Hall of Stories and take the Jagged Crown. Deliver it to General Tullius. Leads to Message to Whiterun.
CWQuest02	|Quest Giver: - Starts automatically after The Jagged Crown (General Tullius).\nLocation: - Solitude, Whiterun (Dragonsreach) and Windhelm.\nOverview: - Deliver the Empire's message to the Jarl of Whiterun and wait for his reply. Take his answer, the axe, to Ulfric in Windhelm, then hurry back to warn Whiterun and report to your field commander.
CWQuest03	|Quest Giver: - Starts automatically after Message to Whiterun.\nLocation: - Whiterun.\nOverview: - Help the Imperials defend Whiterun: hold the barricades, the drawbridge and the gates against the Stormcloak attack until the attackers are beaten, then speak to the Jarl.\nMissable: - Severio Pelagia is killed during the battle.
CWQuest04	|Quest Giver: - Starts automatically after the Battle for Whiterun.\nLocation: - The Imperial military camps across Skyrim.\nOverview: - The campaign to take back the Stormcloak holds, run by Legate Rikke from each hold's Imperial camp: the Pale, the Rift, Winterhold, then Eastmarch and the Battle for Windhelm. Holds given to the Stormcloaks in the peace talks (Season Unending) must be regained first. Ends when Ulfric is defeated.
CWQuest05	|Quest Giver: - Legate Rikke at the Eastmarch Imperial camp, once every other hold is Imperial.\nLocation: - Windhelm and the Palace of the Kings.\nOverview: - Break through the barricades and gates of Windhelm, fight to the Palace of the Kings and force Ulfric Stormcloak to surrender.
CWQuest06	|Quest Giver: - Legate Rikke at the Pale Imperial camp (first Imperial campaign).\nLocation: - The Pale, the Nightgate Inn or Candlehearth Hall (Windhelm), and Dawnstar.\nOverview: - Find the Stormcloak courier at one of the inns, take his documents back to Rikke, then deliver the forged copy to the Stormcloak commander in Dawnstar. Comes before The Battle for Fort Dunstad.
CWQuest07	|Quest Giver: - Legate Rikke at the Rift Imperial camp.\nLocation: - The Rift and Mistveil Keep (Riften).\nOverview: - Find evidence to blackmail Anuriel, Jarl Laila's steward, into revealing a Stormcloak supply delivery. Meet Hadvar's men, ambush the scout and take over the caravan, then report back. Comes before The Battle for Fort Greenwall.
CWQuest08	|Quest Giver: - Starts once you join the Legion.\nLocation: - Castle Dour (Solitude).\nOverview: - Get your free set of Imperial gear from Beirand, the smith in Solitude.
CWQuest09	|Quest Giver: - Legate Rikke at the Winterhold Imperial camp (after the Pale and the Rift are Imperial).\nLocation: - Winterhold Hold and Fort Kastav.\nOverview: - Meet Hadvar and the scouts near Fort Kastav, sneak into the fort, free the Imperial prisoners and take the fort, then report to Hadvar.
CWQuest10	|Quest Giver: - Legate Rikke at the Eastmarch Imperial camp.\nLocation: - Eastmarch and Fort Amol.\nOverview: - Join the soldiers attacking Fort Amol and take it by defeating the defenders. This opens the final assault on Windhelm.
CWQuest11	|Quest Giver: - Legate Rikke at the Pale Imperial camp, after A False Front.\nLocation: - The Pale and Fort Dunstad.\nOverview: - Join the soldiers attacking Fort Dunstad and take it by defeating the defenders. Taking it wins the Pale for the Empire.
CWQuest12	|Quest Giver: - Legate Rikke at the Rift Imperial camp, after Compelling Tribute.\nLocation: - The Rift and Fort Greenwall.\nOverview: - Join the soldiers attacking Fort Greenwall and take it by defeating the defenders. Taking it wins the Rift for the Empire.
CWQuest13	|Quest Giver: - Legate Rikke at the Falkreath Imperial camp.\nLocation: - Falkreath Hold and Fort Neugrad.\nOverview: - Take back Fort Neugrad. This battle only happens if Falkreath Hold went to the Stormcloaks in the peace talks (Season Unending).
CWQuest14	|Quest Giver: - Legate Rikke at the Hjaalmarch Imperial camp.\nLocation: - Hjaalmarch and Fort Snowhawk.\nOverview: - Take back Fort Snowhawk. This battle only happens if Hjaalmarch went to the Stormcloaks in the peace talks (Season Unending).
CWQuest15	|Quest Giver: - Legate Rikke at the Reach Imperial camp.\nLocation: - The Reach and Fort Sungard.\nOverview: - Take back Fort Sungard. This battle only happens if the Reach went to the Stormcloaks in the peace talks (Season Unending).
CWQuest16	|Quest Giver: - Ulfric Stormcloak and Galmar Stone-Fist in the Palace of the Kings, Windhelm.\nLocation: - Windhelm and the Serpent Doomstone (Serpentstone Isle).\nOverview: - To prove yourself, kill the ice wraith at the Serpent Doomstone, return to Galmar and take the Stormcloak oath.\nMissable: - You can only follow one side of the Civil War: joining the Stormcloaks closes the Imperial questline.
CWQuest17	|Quest Giver: - Galmar Stone-Fist.\nLocation: - Windhelm and Korvanjund.\nOverview: - Meet Galmar outside Korvanjund, defeat the Imperial soldiers guarding it, fight through the draugr and open the gate to take the Jagged Crown. Deliver it to Ulfric. Leads to Message to Whiterun.
CWQuest18	|Quest Giver: - Starts automatically after The Jagged Crown (Ulfric Stormcloak).\nLocation: - Windhelm and Whiterun (Dragonsreach).\nOverview: - Take Ulfric's axe to the Jarl of Whiterun, wait for his answer and bring it back to Ulfric, then wait for his orders.
CWQuest19	|Quest Giver: - Starts automatically after Message to Whiterun (Ulfric and Galmar).\nLocation: - Whiterun.\nOverview: - Join Galmar's attack on Whiterun: break through the barricades, open the gate and drawbridge, fight into the city and force Jarl Balgruuf to surrender.\nMissable: - Severio Pelagia is killed during the battle.
CWQuest20	|Quest Giver: - Starts automatically after the Battle for Whiterun.\nLocation: - The Stormcloak military camps across Skyrim.\nOverview: - The campaign to free the Imperial holds, run by Galmar Stone-Fist from each hold's Stormcloak camp: Falkreath, the Reach, Hjaalmarch, then Haafingar and the Battle for Solitude. Holds given to the Empire in the peace talks (Season Unending) must be regained first. Ends when General Tullius is defeated.
CWQuest21	|Quest Giver: - Galmar Stone-Fist at the Haafingar Stormcloak camp, once every other hold is Stormcloak.\nLocation: - Solitude and Castle Dour.\nOverview: - Fight through Solitude's barricades and gates to Castle Dour and force General Tullius to surrender.
CWQuest22	|Quest Giver: - Galmar Stone-Fist at the Hjaalmarch Stormcloak camp.\nLocation: - Hjaalmarch, the Four Shields Tavern (Dragon Bridge) or the Frostfruit Inn (Rorikstead), and Morthal.\nOverview: - Find the Imperial courier at one of the inns, take his documents back to Galmar, then deliver the forged copy to the Imperial commander in Morthal. Comes before The Battle for Fort Snowhawk.
CWQuest23	|Quest Giver: - Galmar Stone-Fist at the Reach Stormcloak camp.\nLocation: - The Reach and Understone Keep (Markarth).\nOverview: - Find evidence to blackmail Raerek, Jarl Igmund's steward, into revealing an Imperial supply delivery. Meet Ralof's men, ambush the scout and take over the caravan, then report back. Comes before The Battle for Fort Sungard.
CWQuest24	|Quest Giver: - Galmar Stone-Fist at the Falkreath Stormcloak camp (first Stormcloak campaign).\nLocation: - Falkreath Hold and Fort Neugrad.\nOverview: - Meet Ralof and the scouts near Fort Neugrad, sneak in, free the Stormcloak prisoners and take the fort, then report to Ralof. Taking it wins Falkreath Hold for the Stormcloaks.
CWQuest25	|Quest Giver: - Galmar Stone-Fist at the Pale Stormcloak camp.\nLocation: - The Pale and Fort Dunstad.\nOverview: - Take back Fort Dunstad. This battle only happens if the Pale went to the Empire in the peace talks (Season Unending).
CWQuest26	|Quest Giver: - Galmar Stone-Fist at the Rift Stormcloak camp.\nLocation: - The Rift and Fort Greenwall.\nOverview: - Take back Fort Greenwall. This battle only happens if the Rift went to the Empire in the peace talks (Season Unending).
CWQuest27	|Quest Giver: - Galmar Stone-Fist at the Haafingar Stormcloak camp, once every other hold is Stormcloak.\nLocation: - Haafingar and Fort Hraggstad.\nOverview: - Join the attack on Fort Hraggstad and take it by defeating the defenders. This opens the final assault on Solitude.
CWQuest28	|Quest Giver: - Galmar Stone-Fist at the Winterhold Stormcloak camp.\nLocation: - Winterhold Hold and Fort Kastav.\nOverview: - Take back Fort Kastav. This battle only happens if Winterhold went to the Empire in the peace talks (Season Unending).
CWQuest29	|Quest Giver: - Galmar Stone-Fist at the Hjaalmarch Stormcloak camp, after A False Front.\nLocation: - Hjaalmarch and Fort Snowhawk.\nOverview: - Join the attack on Fort Snowhawk and take it by defeating the defenders. Taking it wins Hjaalmarch for the Stormcloaks.
CWQuest30	|Quest Giver: - Galmar Stone-Fist at the Reach Stormcloak camp, after Compelling Tribute.\nLocation: - The Reach and Fort Sungard.\nOverview: - Join the attack on Fort Sungard and take it by defeating the defenders. Taking it wins the Reach for the Stormcloaks.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Main quest: Dawnguard
----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Main_DG_Quest00	|Quest Giver: - Durak, who approaches you at level 10 after you enter a settlement; guards also mention the Dawnguard.\nLocation: - Fort Dawnguard.\nOverview: - Hear of the Dawnguard vampire hunters, find Fort Dawnguard (Dayspring Canyon, southeast of Riften) and speak to Isran and Vigilant Tolan. You receive a crossbow and bolts.
Main_DG_Quest01	|Quest Giver: - Isran.\nLocation: - Dimhollow Crypt.\nOverview: - Isran sends you to Dimhollow Crypt to find out what the vampires are after. Solve the puzzle inside and speak to the mysterious woman, Serana.
Main_DG_Quest02	|Quest Giver: - Serana.\nLocation: - Dimhollow Crypt, Icewater Jetty and Castle Volkihar.\nOverview: - Escort Serana to Castle Volkihar, where her father Lord Harkon offers you a gift. You decide here whether to join the vampires or stay loyal to the Dawnguard.\nMissable: - Permanent choice of side. Accepting Harkon's offer locks the Dawnguard quests (A New Order, Prophet from Isran); refusing locks the vampire quests (The Bloodstone Chalice, Prophet from Harkon).
Main_DG_Quest03	|Quest Giver: - Isran.\nLocation: - Various; Fort Dawnguard.\nOverview: - Rebuild the Dawnguard: help Gunmar with a bear and bring Sorine Jurard to the fort, then hear Isran's speech. Unlocks Dawnguard membership and the Dawnguard radiant quests.\nMissable: - Only available if you reject Lord Harkon's offer in Bloodline.
Main_DG_Quest04	|Quest Giver: - Isran.\nLocation: - Fort Dawnguard, Dragon Bridge and Forebears' Holdout.\nOverview: - Find a Moth Priest who can read the Elder Scroll. Search the road south of Dragon Bridge, find the scene of the attack and rescue the priest from Forebears' Holdout, then report to Isran.\nMissable: - Only on the Dawnguard side; the vampire version of Prophet is the other path.
Main_DG_Quest05	|Quest Giver: - Garan Marethi (starts automatically after you accept Harkon's gift).\nLocation: - Redwater Den.\nOverview: - Take the Bloodstone Chalice to the Bloodspring at Redwater Den and fill it. Stalf and Salonia Caelia ambush you, so defeat them, add vampire blood to the chalice and return to Garan Marethi. Unlocks Volkihar clan membership and the vampire radiant quests.\nMissable: - Only if you accept Lord Harkon's offer in Bloodline.
Main_DG_Quest06	|Quest Giver: - Lord Harkon.\nLocation: - Volkihar Keep, Dragon Bridge and Forebears' Holdout.\nOverview: - Harkon needs a Moth Priest to read the Elder Scroll. Follow the trail through Solitude and Dragon Bridge to Forebears' Holdout, defeat the enthralled priest, use Vampire's Seduction on him, feed on him to make him your thrall and report back to Harkon.\nMissable: - Only on the vampire side; the Dawnguard version of Prophet is the other path.
Main_DG_Quest07	|Quest Giver: - Starts automatically after Prophet; Serana asks you to find her mother.\nLocation: - Castle Volkihar.\nOverview: - Explore Castle Volkihar with Serana, investigate the Moondial and the ruined tower, and find Valerica's journal. To enter the Soul Cairn you must become a vampire (Serana turns you) or be partially soul trapped.
Main_DG_Quest08	|Quest Giver: - Dexion Evicus.\nLocation: - College of Winterhold.\nOverview: - To find Auriel's Bow you need the Elder Scroll (Dragon). Ask at the College of Winterhold, where Urag gro-Shub bought the scroll, and buy it back from him.
Main_DG_Quest09	|Quest Giver: - Starts automatically when you enter the Soul Cairn.\nLocation: - The Soul Cairn.\nOverview: - Find Serana's mother Valerica, kill the Boneyard Keepers, defeat the dragon Durnehviir and take the Elder Scroll (Blood). Non-vampires must also return a soul essence gem. Rewards the Summon Durnehviir shout.
Main_DG_Quest10	|Quest Giver: - Dexion Evicus.\nLocation: - Various.\nOverview: - Gather both the Dragon and Blood Elder Scrolls and bring them to Dexion.
Main_DG_Quest11	|Quest Giver: - Dexion Evicus.\nLocation: - Ancestor Glade.\nOverview: - To read the Elder Scroll you need a Moth Priest's draw knife and bark from a Canticle Tree, then attract Ancestor Moth swarms at Ancestor Glade. Read the scroll and talk to Serana.
Main_DG_Quest12	|Quest Giver: - Serana.\nLocation: - Darkfall Cave, Darkfall Passage, Forgotten Vale, Glacial Crevice and Inner Sanctum.\nOverview: - The vision shows you where Auriel's Bow is. Speak to Gelebor in the Forgotten Vale, fill the Initiate's Ewer, kill Vyrthur and take the bow. Rewards Auriel's Bow and a Drain Vitality word.
Main_DG_Quest13	|Quest Giver: - Starts automatically when you take Auriel's Bow.\nLocation: - Fort Dawnguard and Volkihar Keep.\nOverview: - Rally the Dawnguard (on that side) and confront Lord Harkon with Auriel's Bow, then kill him. On the vampire side Garan Marethi tells you the castle is yours. Serana can later be talked into curing herself.\nNOTE: Do not start this quest until 'The Forgemaster's Fingers' has been started.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Main quest: Dragonborn
----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Main_DB_Quest00	|Quest Giver: - Starts automatically with a cultist ambush (after The Way of the Voice, while you are away from Solstheim).\nLocation: - Northern Maiden, Raven Rock, the Earth Stone and Temple of Miraak.\nOverview: - Survive the cultist attack and find a note on a body. Speak to Gjalund Salt-Sage at the Windhelm docks for passage to Solstheim, ask in Raven Rock about Miraak, and reach his temple. Unlocks access to Solstheim.
Main_DB_Quest01	|Quest Giver: - Starts automatically after Dragonborn.\nLocation: - Temple of Miraak.\nOverview: - Travel through the temple, meet Frea and read the Black Book Waking Dreams at the end. Unlocks a Dragon Aspect word.
Main_DB_Quest02	|Quest Giver: - Frea.\nLocation: - Skaal Village, Saering's Watch and the Wind Stone.\nOverview: - Go with Frea to Skaal Village and speak to Storn Crag-Strider. Learn a Word of Bend Will at Saering's Watch, use the Shout on the Wind Stone to free the Skaal, then defeat the Lurker it releases and talk to Storn again. Afterwards Frea will follow you once she likes you.
Main_DB_Quest03	|Quest Giver: - Storn Crag-Strider.\nLocation: - The Beast, Earth, Sun and Water Stones on Solstheim.\nOverview: - Use the Bend Will shout on each of the four remaining All-Maker Stones to cleanse them, restoring their powers.
Main_DB_Quest04	|Quest Giver: - Storn Crag-Strider.\nLocation: - Tel Mithryn and Nchardak.\nOverview: - Storn suggests Neloth can help find the Black Books. Speak to Neloth in Tel Mithryn, travel with him to the Dwemer ruin Nchardak, restore the steam supply to the reading room and take the Black Book Epistolary Acumen. Cleansing the Stones starts at the same time.
Main_DB_Quest05	|Quest Giver: - Read the Black Book Epistolary Acumen.\nLocation: - Apocrypha, Nchardak and Skaal Village.\nOverview: - The Black Book takes you to Hermaeus Mora's realm, where he teaches you the second Word of Bend Will and promises the third in return for the secrets of the Skaal. Storn agrees, but Mora kills him when he reads the book, teaching you the final Word. A dragon, Krosulhah, appears at Nchardak when you return.\nMissable: - Storn dies, so he can no longer be talked to afterwards.
Main_DB_Quest06	|Quest Giver: - Frea.\nLocation: - Apocrypha.\nOverview: - With the final Word of Bend Will unlocked, read Waking Dreams again and reach Miraak's temple in Apocrypha, use the Shout to tame the dragon Sahrotaar and defeat Miraak. Rewards Miraak's gear and the Tree Stone power. Best reward at level 60+.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Dawnstar
----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Dawnstar_Quest00	|Quest Giver: - An innkeeper, Jarl Skald or the steward (bounty letter).\nLocation: - Dawnstar and a nearby giant camp.\nOverview: - Take the bounty on a giant, kill it at its camp and return to the Jarl or steward for the reward.
Dawnstar_Quest01	|Quest Giver: - Silus Vesuius (a museum pamphlet from a courier starts it).\nLocation: - Silus Vesuius's house (Dawnstar), Dead Crone Rock, Cracked Tusk Keep and the Shrine of Mehrunes Dagon.\nOverview: - Silus wants the three pieces of the broken Mehrunes' Razor for his museum of the Mythic Dawn. Collect them, reassemble the dagger and decide what to do with it.\nMissable: - It fails if Silus Vesuius dies.
Dawnstar_Quest02	|Quest Giver: - Erandur.\nLocation: - The Windpeak Inn (Dawnstar) and Nightcaller Temple.\nOverview: - Dawnstar's people suffer terrible nightmares. Follow Erandur to Nightcaller Temple, fight through to the library and find the book The Dreamstride to end the curse.
Dawnstar_Quest03	|Quest Giver: - Captain Wayfinder.\nLocation: - His ship at the Dawnstar docks and a random location.\nOverview: - Retrieve the salts from the named location and bring them back for your reward.
Dawnstar_Quest04	|Quest Giver: - Frida.\nLocation: - Dawnstar and a random dungeon.\nOverview: - Retrieve the Ring of Pure Mixtures from a dungeon and bring it to Frida.
Dawnstar_Quest05	|Quest Giver: - Karl.\nLocation: - Dawnstar.\nOverview: - Buy a drink for Karl. Improves his disposition.
Dawnstar_Quest06	|Quest Giver: - Rustleif.\nLocation: - Dawnstar.\nOverview: - Rustleif asks you to find a rare item he wants to give as a gift.
Dawnstar_Quest07	|Quest Giver: - The Jarl of the Pale (befriend them first).\nLocation: - The Pale.\nOverview: - Befriend the Jarl, assist three people of the Pale and return to the Jarl for the title of Thane.
Dawnstar_Quest08	|Quest Giver: - Beitild.\nLocation: - Dawnstar.\nOverview: - Mine the ore Beitild asks for and bring it back.
Dawnstar_Quest09	|Quest Giver: - Leigelf.\nLocation: - Dawnstar.\nOverview: - Mine the ore Leigelf asks for and bring it back.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Falkreath
----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Falkreath_Quest00	|Quest Giver: - Barbas (talk to Lod in Falkreath first).\nLocation: - Falkreath, Haemar's Shame and Rimerock Burrow.\nOverview: - Track down Barbas, Clavicus Vile's dog, travel with him to Haemar's Shame, retrieve the Rueful Axe and give it to Clavicus Vile, or kill Barbas. The choice decides your reward.
Falkreath_Quest01	|Quest Giver: - Dengeir of Stuhn.\nLocation: - Falkreath and Bloodlet Throne.\nOverview: - Battle through Bloodlet Throne and kill the vampire Vighar, then return to Dengeir.
Falkreath_Quest02	|Quest Giver: - Mathies or Sinding.\nLocation: - Falkreath (jail) and Bloated Man's Grotto.\nOverview: - Talk to Sinding in Falkreath Jail, hunt the White Stag for Hircine and accept Hircine's challenge. Agreeing to help Sinding without speaking to J'Keir first fails the hunt objective.\nMissable: - It fails if Sinding dies before you join the hunt.
Falkreath_Quest03	|Quest Giver: - Jarl Siddgeir.\nLocation: - Falkreath and a random dungeon.\nOverview: - Travel to the assigned dungeon, kill the bandit leader and report back to Siddgeir.
Falkreath_Quest04	|Quest Giver: - Hert.\nLocation: - Falkreath.\nOverview: - Chop firewood for Hert for a small payment.
Falkreath_Quest05	|Quest Giver: - Thadgeir.\nLocation: - Falkreath.\nOverview: - Deliver Berit's ashes to Runil. Pays gold.
Falkreath_Quest06	|Quest Giver: - Runil.\nLocation: - Falkreath and a random cave.\nOverview: - Fight or sneak through a cave, retrieve Runil's journal and return it.
Falkreath_Quest07	|Quest Giver: - Mathies.\nLocation: - Falkreath.\nOverview: - Harvest wheat from Mathies's farm for a small payment.
Falkreath_Quest08	|Quest Giver: - Jarl Siddgeir.\nLocation: - Falkreath.\nOverview: - Siddgeir asks you to find a rare item he wants to give as a gift.
Falkreath_Quest09	|Quest Giver: - Dengeir of Stuhn.\nLocation: - Falkreath.\nOverview: - Steal the item Dengeir names and return it for gold and skill points.
Falkreath_Quest10	|Quest Giver: - The Jarl of Falkreath (befriend them first).\nLocation: - Falkreath Hold.\nOverview: - Befriend the Jarl, assist three people of Falkreath Hold and return for the title of Thane.
Falkreath_Quest11	|Quest Giver: - Runil, once you have read his journal.\nLocation: - Falkreath.\nOverview: - Tell Runil that his journal suggests he is troubled by his past. He admits he is afraid of what you will think of him, then opens up about the things he has done. A short conversation with no reward. Added by the mod Cutting Room Floor.

-- Markarth
----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Markarth_Quest00	|Quest Giver: - Bothela.\nLocation: - The Hag's Cure and Understone Keep (Markarth).\nOverview: - Collect a potion from Bothela and deliver it discreetly to Raerek or Reburrus in Understone Keep (or the Blue Palace in Solitude). Pays levelled gold.
Markarth_Quest01	|Quest Giver: - A courier.\nLocation: - Any city shop and Markarth.\nOverview: - Buy a Dwarven item from a shop, receive the courier's message and sell it to Calcelmo in Understone Keep for a varying amount of gold.
Markarth_Quest02	|Quest Giver: - Moth gro-Bagol.\nLocation: - Understone Keep (Markarth).\nOverview: - Moth gro-Bagol wants a Daedra heart. Bring one back for random levelled armour.
Markarth_Quest03	|Quest Giver: - Kerah.\nLocation: - Understone Keep (Markarth).\nOverview: - Take Calcelmo's ring from Kerah to Calcelmo in Understone Keep for levelled gold.
Markarth_Quest04	|Quest Giver: - Jarl Igmund.\nLocation: - Understone Keep and a random Forsworn dungeon.\nOverview: - Kill the Forsworn leader in a dungeon Igmund names and return to him for levelled gold.
Markarth_Quest05	|Quest Giver: - Lisbet.\nLocation: - Arnleif and Sons Trading Company (Markarth).\nOverview: - Lisbet's shipment of a Dibella statue has gone missing. Retrieve it and return it for levelled gold.
Markarth_Quest06	|Quest Giver: - Calcelmo.\nLocation: - Understone Keep and Nchuand-Zel.\nOverview: - Calcelmo asks you to kill Nimhe, a giant frostbite spider. Rewards access to the Dwemer Museum and Nchuand-Zel.
Markarth_Quest07	|Quest Giver: - Starts automatically when you are jailed after The Forsworn Conspiracy.\nLocation: - Cidhna Mine, Markarth.\nOverview: - In prison, brawl, bribe or lie your way to a meeting with Madanach, then follow his plan to escape with the prisoners or kill him. Rewards a Shiv and a family ring and/or the Armor of the Old Gods depending on your choices.
Markarth_Quest08	|Quest Giver: - Ondolemar.\nLocation: - Markarth.\nOverview: - Ondolemar wants you to steal Ogmund's Amulet of Talos from his house and bring it to him. Pays levelled gold.
Markarth_Quest09	|Quest Giver: - Ghorza gra-Bagol.\nLocation: - Ghorza's blacksmith shop (Markarth) and Fort Sungard.\nOverview: - Ghorza wants the skill book Last Scabbard of Akrash. Fetch it from Fort Sungard for a free Smithing lesson.
Markarth_Quest10	|Quest Giver: - Eltrys, or starts automatically when you read his note.\nLocation: - Markarth.\nOverview: - Meet Eltrys in the Shrine of Talos, find evidence about Margret and uncover the Silver-Blood corruption. Report what you learn to Eltrys, who pays you for each lead.
Markarth_Quest11	|Quest Giver: - Degaine, the beggar in Markarth.\nLocation: - Markarth and the Temple of Dibella.\nOverview: - Degaine asks you to steal the statue of Dibella from the Temple of Dibella and bring it to him.
Markarth_Quest12	|Quest Giver: - Hamal.\nLocation: - Markarth (Temple of Dibella), Karthwasten and Broken Tower Redoubt.\nOverview: - The second part of The Heart of Dibella, finding the new Sybil. Rewards the Agent of Dibella status and Enchanting training.
Markarth_Quest13	|Quest Giver: - Vigilant Tyranus.\nLocation: - Markarth (the abandoned house).\nOverview: - Enter the abandoned house, kill Vigilant Tyranus, speak with Molag Bal, release Logrolf the Willful, make him bow and kill him. Rewards the Mace of Molag Bal.
Markarth_Quest14	|Quest Giver: - Calcelmo, via Alethius's note.\nLocation: - Nchuand-Zel.\nOverview: - Investigate the dig site, recover Alethius's note and the expedition members' journals, then re-activate Nchuand-Zel's automated defences. Pays levelled gold.
Markarth_Quest15	|Quest Giver: - Kleppr, Frabbi, Brother Verulus or Eola.\nLocation: - Markarth (Hall of the Dead, Silver-Blood Inn) and Reachcliff Cave.\nOverview: - Investigate the desecration of the Hall of the Dead and clear Reachcliff Cave of undead. Rewards depend on how you finish: the Ring of Namira and gold, or the Amulet of Arkay.
Markarth_Quest16	|Quest Giver: - Kleppr, Frabbi, Brother Verulus or Eola.\nLocation: - Markarth (Hall of the Dead, Silver-Blood Inn) and Reachcliff Cave.\nOverview: - Bring a fresh kill to Namira's shrine and do the unthinkable for your reward. Rewards the Ring of Namira and levelled gold (Amulet of Arkay if you take the favour path instead).
Markarth_Quest17	|Quest Giver: - Omluag.\nLocation: - Markarth.\nOverview: - Talk to Mulush gro-Shugurz on Omluag's behalf (persuade, bribe, intimidate or brawl) and report back.
Markarth_Quest18	|Quest Giver: - Banning.\nLocation: - Markarth.\nOverview: - Deliver spiced beef to Voada. Pays levelled gold.
Markarth_Quest19	|Quest Giver: - Jarl Igmund.\nLocation: - Understone Keep and a random dungeon.\nOverview: - Find Hrolfdir's Shield and bring it back to Igmund. Rewards levelled armour and the ability to buy Vlindrel Hall.
Markarth_Quest20	|Quest Giver: - Cosnach.\nLocation: - Markarth.\nOverview: - Challenge Cosnach to a brawl and win. Pays 100 gold.
Markarth_Quest21	|Quest Giver: - Degaine.\nLocation: - Markarth.\nOverview: - Give a septim to the beggar Degaine.
Markarth_Quest22	|Quest Giver: - Degaine.\nLocation: - Markarth.\nOverview: - Buy a drink for Degaine. Improves his disposition.
Markarth_Quest23	|Quest Giver: - Cosnach.\nLocation: - Markarth.\nOverview: - Buy a drink for Cosnach. Improves his disposition.
Markarth_Quest24	|Quest Giver: - Jarl Igmund (befriend him first).\nLocation: - The Reach.\nOverview: - Complete the Jarl's favour quest, assist five people of the Reach and purchase Vlindrel Hall, then return to the Jarl. Rewards the title of Thane and the Blade of the Reach.

Companions_Quest00	|Quest Giver: - Starts once you look for the Companions; speak to Kodlak Whitemane in Jorrvaskr.\nLocation: - Jorrvaskr (Whiterun).\nOverview: - Speak to Kodlak, prove yourself in a sparring match with Vilkas, then run errands for the members: take Vilkas's sword to Eorlund Gray-Mane and bring Aela her shield. Rewards Companions membership.
Companions_Quest01	|Quest Giver: - Skjor (after completing one radiant Companions job).\nLocation: - Jorrvaskr and Dustman's Cairn.\nOverview: - Go with Farkas to Dustman's Cairn, retrieve a fragment of Wuuthrad and take part in your own initiation. Rewards a Skyforge Steel weapon and a Fire Breath word.
Companions_Quest02	|Quest Giver: - Skjor.\nLocation: - Whiterun, the Underforge and Gallows Rock.\nOverview: - Meet Skjor at night, enter the Underforge and take part in the blood ritual. Then join Aela in killing the werewolf hunters at Gallows Rock. Rewards lycanthropy.
Companions_Quest03	|Quest Giver: - Kodlak Whitemane.\nLocation: - Jorrvaskr and the Glenmoril Coven.\nOverview: - Kodlak wants a cure for his curse. Collect a Glenmoril witch's head, optionally wipe out the coven, and return it to him.
Companions_Quest04	|Quest Giver: - Vilkas.\nLocation: - Jorrvaskr and Driftshade Refuge.\nOverview: - With Vilkas as your shield-brother, infiltrate the Silver Hand's refuge, retrieve the fragments of Wuuthrad and optionally wipe out the Silver Hand.
Companions_Quest05	|Quest Giver: - Starts automatically after Purity of Revenge.\nLocation: - Jorrvaskr, the Skyforge and Ysgramor's Tomb.\nOverview: - Attend Kodlak's funeral, give the fragments of Wuuthrad to Eorlund, retrieve Kodlak's own fragment and have the axe mended. Return Wuuthrad to Ysgramor's Tomb, fight through, meet Kodlak's spirit and free him. Rewards Wuuthrad, the Shield of Ysgramor, an Animal Allegiance word and the title of Harbinger.
Companions_Quest06	|Quest Giver: - Aela the Huntress.\nOverview: - Kill the invading beast.
Companions_Quest07	|Quest Giver: - Aela the Huntress.\nLocation: - Jorrvaskr (Whiterun) and a random animal den.\nOverview: - Aela sends you to clear a beast den, then return for levelled gold.
Companions_Quest08	|Quest Giver: - Aela the Huntress, once you are a member of the Companions.\nLocation: - Jorrvaskr (Whiterun) and the wilds of Skyrim.\nOverview: - Aela wants animal pelts for the Companions. Bring back the number she asks for, a random amount between three and seven of one kind of pelt. Repeatable job. Added by the mod Cutting Room Floor.
Companions_Quest09	|Quest Giver: - Farkas or Vilkas.\nLocation: - Jorrvaskr and a dragon lair.\nOverview: - Travel to a dragon lair, kill the dragon and report back for levelled gold.
Companions_Quest10	|Quest Giver: - Skjor or Vilkas.\nLocation: - Jorrvaskr and a random hold.\nOverview: - Track down and kill a criminal who escaped justice, then collect levelled gold.
Companions_Quest11	|Quest Giver: - Skjor or Vilkas.\nLocation: - Jorrvaskr and a random location.\nOverview: - Retrieve a family heirloom from the boss chest at a location, then return it for gold.
Companions_Quest12	|Quest Giver: - Farkas.\nLocation: - Jorrvaskr and a random town.\nOverview: - Speak to the target and beat them up without killing them to send a message, then return to Farkas for gold.
Companions_Quest13	|Quest Giver: - Farkas or Vilkas.\nLocation: - Jorrvaskr and Ysgramor's Tomb.\nOverview: - Help a brother cure his lycanthropy by taking a Glenmoril witch's head to Ysgramor's Tomb and defeating his wolf spirit. Rewards levelled gold.
Companions_Quest14	|Quest Giver: - Farkas or Vilkas.\nLocation: - Jorrvaskr and Ysgramor's Tomb.\nOverview: - Help the other brother do the same by taking a Glenmoril witch's head to Ysgramor's Tomb and defeating his wolf spirit. Rewards levelled gold.
Companions_Quest15	|Quest Giver: - Skjor or Vilkas.\nLocation: - Jorrvaskr and a random location.\nOverview: - Rescue a citizen from the enemies holding them and escort them home. Rewards levelled gold.
Companions_Quest16	|Quest Giver: - Aela the Huntress.\nLocation: - Jorrvaskr and a random location.\nOverview: - Travel to a fragment of Wuuthrad, fight the enemies there and bring it back to Jorrvaskr.
Companions_Quest17	|Quest Giver: - Aela the Huntress.\nLocation: - Jorrvaskr and a Silver Hand location.\nOverview: - Retrieve the Silver Hand's stratagem and return it to Aela for gold.
Companions_Quest18	|Quest Giver: - Aela the Huntress.\nLocation: - Jorrvaskr and a Silver Hand hideout.\nOverview: - Travel to the hideout, kill the Silver Hand leader and return to Aela for gold.
Companions_Quest19	|Quest Giver: - Aela the Huntress.\nLocation: - Jorrvaskr, the Underforge and various sites.\nOverview: - Retrieve three Totems of Hircine from the marked locations by any means and bring them to the Underforge receptacles. Rewards a Totem of Hircine and levelled gold.\nNOTE: This quest moves to completed automatically after the third totem.
Companions_Quest20	|Quest Giver: - Farkas.\nLocation: - Jorrvaskr and a random location.\nOverview: - Kill the leader of the assigned location and return to Farkas for gold.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Dark Brotherhood
----------------------------------------------------------------------------
DarkBrotherhood_Quest00	|Quest Giver: - Aventus Aretino.\nLocation: - Aretino Residence (Windhelm) and the Honorhall Orphanage (Riften).\nOverview: - Aventus, a young boy, asks you to kill Grelod the Kind at the Honorhall Orphanage in Riften. Do it and return for your reward and a mysterious note, which leads to the Dark Brotherhood. Rewards the Aretino family heirloom.
DarkBrotherhood_Quest01	|Quest Giver: - Cicero, on the road to Loreius Farm.\nLocation: - Loreius Farm.\nOverview: - Cicero is transporting the Night Mother's coffin and his cart wheel is broken. Speak to Vantus Loreius at the farm and either persuade him to fix the wheel or hand Cicero over to a guard. Rewards levelled gold.\nMissable: - Must be done before you enter the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary in With Friends Like These..., or it fails or becomes permanently unavailable.
DarkBrotherhood_Quest02	|Quest Giver: - Astrid (after you sleep following Innocence Lost).\nLocation: - Abandoned Shack and the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary.\nOverview: - Kidnapped and locked in an abandoned shack, you are told to kill either a captive or Astrid, the Brotherhood's leader. The choice decides whether you join the Dark Brotherhood or destroy it. Rewards Shrouded Armor, a Marked for Death word and membership.\nMissable: - Killing Astrid puts you on the Destroy the Dark Brotherhood! path and locks the rest of the Brotherhood questline, and entering the Sanctuary ends the Delayed Burial opportunity.
DarkBrotherhood_Quest03	|Quest Giver: - Astrid.\nLocation: - Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary.\nOverview: - Finish talking to Astrid, meet your new family members and take your first contracts from Nazir. Rewards the Shrouded Robes, Hood, Hand Wraps and Shoes.
DarkBrotherhood_Quest04	|Quest Giver: - Astrid.\nLocation: - Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary, Windhelm, Markarth and Raldbthar.\nOverview: - Muiri in Markarth wants revenge. Kill Alain Dufont at his Raldbthar hideout and, optionally, Nilsine Shatter-Shield in Windhelm, then return to Muiri. Doing the optional kill earns her ring as well as gold.\nNOTE: This quest should be completed before starting 'Lost to the Ages' and after completing 'Blood on the Ice' as well as 'Rare Gifts (Torbjorn Shatter-Shield)'.
DarkBrotherhood_Quest05	|Quest Giver: - Astrid.\nLocation: - Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary.\nOverview: - Hide in the Night Mother's coffin and listen to Cicero. Step out to confront Cicero and Astrid, then take contracts from Nazir.
DarkBrotherhood_Quest06	|Quest Giver: - Astrid.\nLocation: - Volunruud, the Ragged Flagon (Riften) and the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary.\nOverview: - Meet the client, Amaund Motierre, in Volunruud and take his letter and amulet to Astrid. Delvin Mallory buys the amulet and gives you a letter of credit; take it to Rexus for the payment, then report to Astrid.
DarkBrotherhood_Quest07	|Quest Giver: - Astrid.\nLocation: - Solitude and the Temple of the Divines.\nOverview: - Attend the wedding at the Temple of the Divines and assassinate Vittoria Vici, with a bonus for killing her during her speech. Return to Astrid. Rewards Summon Spectral Assassin and levelled gold.
DarkBrotherhood_Quest08	|Quest Giver: - Astrid (through Gabriella at the Sanctuary).\nLocation: - Dragon Bridge, major cities and the roads between.\nOverview: - Optionally steal Gaius Maro's travel schedule, then kill him and plant the incriminating letter, with a bonus for killing him in a major city. Rewards levelled gold.\nMissable: - Killing Gaius Maro inside a major city earns Olava's Token from Gabriella, which starts 'Locate the Assassin of Old'. Without it that quest is missed.
DarkBrotherhood_Quest09	|Quest Giver: - Astrid.\nLocation: - Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary and the abandoned Sanctuary at Dawnstar.\nOverview: - Cicero has gone mad and attacked Astrid. Search his room and read his diary, report to Astrid, ask Arnbjorn where Cicero went, then follow him into the old Dawnstar Sanctuary and kill him, or leave and let him live. Report to Astrid; Shadowmere is your reward.\nMissable: - Sparing Cicero lets him become your friend and follower later; killing him ends that.
DarkBrotherhood_Quest10	|Quest Giver: - Astrid.\nLocation: - Markarth and Nightgate Inn (Dawnstar).\nOverview: - Talk to Festus Krex, then find Anton Virane and make him talk. Kill Anton, find and kill Balagog gro-Nolob and take his invitation, optionally hiding the body. Return to Festus Krex for gold and possibly Nightweaver's Band.
DarkBrotherhood_Quest11	|Quest Giver: - Astrid.\nLocation: - Dragon Bridge, Solitude (Castle Dour) and the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary.\nOverview: - Report to Commander Maro of the Penitus Oculatus at Dragon Bridge, then go to Castle Dour, report to the cook Gianna in a chef's hat and help prepare the Emperor's feast, poisoning his stew. Escape the castle and return to the Sanctuary.
DarkBrotherhood_Quest12	|Quest Giver: - Starts automatically when you return to the Sanctuary after To Kill an Empire.\nLocation: - Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary (Falkreath).\nOverview: - The Penitus Oculatus have attacked the Sanctuary. Search for survivors, kill the Legion soldiers inside and Nazir's attacker. Rewards the Blade of Woe.
DarkBrotherhood_Quest13	|Quest Giver: - Nazir (after Death Incarnate).\nLocation: - Whiterun, the Solitude docks and the Katariah.\nOverview: - Talk to Nazir, then to Amaund Motierre, who tells you where the real Emperor is. Board the Katariah in Solitude, kill Emperor Titus Mede II and return to Amaund for payment. Rewards gold and the Dawnstar Sanctuary as the Brotherhood's new home.
DarkBrotherhood_Quest14	|Quest Giver: - Starts automatically after you kill Astrid in With Friends Like These....\nLocation: - Abandoned Shack, Dragon Bridge and the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary.\nOverview: - Tell a guard what happened, speak to Commander Maro at Dragon Bridge and help destroy the Dark Brotherhood in the Sanctuary. Rewards 3,000 gold and a Marked for Death word.\nMissable: - This is the opposite path to joining the Brotherhood; taking it locks the Brotherhood questline.
DarkBrotherhood_Quest15	|Quest Giver: - Nazir.\nLocation: - Fort Greymoor.\nOverview: - Kill Agnis for the Dark Brotherhood and return to Nazir for levelled gold.
DarkBrotherhood_Quest16	|Quest Giver: - Nazir.\nLocation: - Whiterun.\nOverview: - Kill Anoriath and return to Nazir for levelled gold.
DarkBrotherhood_Quest17	|Quest Giver: - Nazir.\nLocation: - Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary and Dawnstar.\nOverview: - Kill Beitild in Dawnstar and return to Nazir for levelled gold.
DarkBrotherhood_Quest18	|Quest Giver: - Nazir.\nLocation: - Hela's Folly.\nOverview: - Travel to Hela's Folly, assassinate Deekus and report back to Nazir for levelled gold.
DarkBrotherhood_Quest19	|Quest Giver: - Nazir.\nLocation: - Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary and Anga's Mill.\nOverview: - Travel to Anga's Mill, kill Ennodius Papius and report back to Nazir for levelled gold.
DarkBrotherhood_Quest20	|Quest Giver: - Nazir.\nLocation: - Falkreath.\nOverview: - Kill Helvard in Falkreath and return to Nazir for levelled gold.
DarkBrotherhood_Quest21	|Quest Giver: - Nazir.\nLocation: - Half-Moon Mill.\nOverview: - Go to Half-Moon Mill, kill Hern the vampire and return to Nazir for levelled gold.
DarkBrotherhood_Quest22	|Quest Giver: - Nazir.\nLocation: - Moorside Inn, Morthal.\nOverview: - Find Lurbuk at the Moorside Inn, kill him and return to Nazir for levelled gold.
DarkBrotherhood_Quest23	|Quest Giver: - Nazir.\nLocation: - Mzinchaleft.\nOverview: - Kill Maluril in Mzinchaleft and report back to Nazir for levelled gold.
DarkBrotherhood_Quest24	|Quest Giver: - Nazir.\nLocation: - Varies; Ma'randru-jo can be found and killed in the world.\nOverview: - Locate and kill Ma'randru-jo, then return to Nazir for levelled gold.
DarkBrotherhood_Quest25	|Quest Giver: - Nazir.\nLocation: - Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary and Ivarstead.\nOverview: - Travel to Ivarstead, kill the beggar Narfi near his home and report back to Nazir for levelled gold.\nMissable: - Killing Narfi ends the Ivarstead quest 'The Straw that Broke', which he gives.
DarkBrotherhood_Quest26	|Quest Giver: - Nazir.\nLocation: - Solitude harbour and the ship the Red Wave.\nOverview: - Board the Red Wave, kill Safia and report back to Nazir for levelled gold.
DarkBrotherhood_Quest27	|Quest Giver: - Olava the Feeble.\nLocation: - Whiterun, Deepwood Redoubt and Hag's End.\nOverview: - Olava the Feeble tells you of an old Brotherhood assassin. Travel to Deepwood Redoubt, make your way to Hag's End, optionally defeat the hagraven, and find the assassin behind a hidden wall. Rewards Ancient Shrouded Armor. Needs Olava's Token, earned by killing Gaius Maro in a major city during Breaching Security.
DarkBrotherhood_Quest28	|Quest Giver: - The torture victims in the Dawnstar Sanctuary.\nLocation: - Dawnstar Sanctuary.\nOverview: - Buy the torture room upgrade from Delvin Mallory, then talk repeatedly to any of the four victims to learn where treasure is hidden, and take it. Pays 1000 to 2000 gold.
DarkBrotherhood_Quest29	|Quest Giver: - The torture victims in the Dawnstar Sanctuary.\nLocation: - Dawnstar Sanctuary.\nOverview: - Buy the torture room upgrade from Delvin Mallory, then talk repeatedly to any of the four victims to learn where treasure is hidden, and take it. Pays 1000 to 2000 gold.
DarkBrotherhood_Quest30	|Quest Giver: - The torture victims in the Dawnstar Sanctuary.\nLocation: - Dawnstar Sanctuary.\nOverview: - Buy the torture room upgrade from Delvin Mallory, then talk repeatedly to any of the four victims to learn where treasure is hidden, and take it. Pays 1000 to 2000 gold.
DarkBrotherhood_Quest31	|Quest Giver: - The torture victims in the Dawnstar Sanctuary.\nLocation: - Dawnstar Sanctuary.\nOverview: - Buy the torture room upgrade from Delvin Mallory, then talk repeatedly to any of the four victims to learn where treasure is hidden, and take it. Pays 1000 to 2000 gold.
DarkBrotherhood_Quest32	|Quest Giver: - Nazir.\nLocation: - Dawnstar Sanctuary and The Ragged Flagon.\nOverview: - Talk to Nazir in the new Dawnstar Sanctuary, speak to Delvin Mallory and buy the upgrades to refurnish the Sanctuary.
DarkBrotherhood_Quest33	|Quest Giver: - The Night Mother.\nLocation: - Dawnstar Sanctuary.\nOverview: - Approach the Night Mother, speak to the contact and kill the target for a medium levelled gold reward.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Thieves Guild
----------------------------------------------------------------------------
ThievesGuild_Quest00	|Quest Giver: - Brynjolf.\nLocation: - Riften.\nOverview: - Brynjolf wants you to steal Madesi's silver ring from a stall in Riften and plant it elsewhere, proving you can do the job. Rewards 100 gold.
ThievesGuild_Quest01	|Quest Giver: - Brynjolf.\nLocation: - The Ragged Flagon and Riften.\nOverview: - Collect overdue debts from Keerava, Bersi Honey-Hand and Haelga, then report to Brynjolf. Rewards Thieves Guild membership and three levelled potions depending on how you handled each debt.
ThievesGuild_Quest02	|Quest Giver: - Brynjolf.\nLocation: - Goldenglow Estate (Riften).\nOverview: - Break into Goldenglow Estate, burn three beehives, open Aringoth's safe and take the Goldenglow Bill of Sale. Rewards levelled gold.
ThievesGuild_Quest03	|Quest Giver: - Brynjolf.\nLocation: - The Bannered Mare (Whiterun), Honningbrew Meadery and Riften.\nOverview: - Maven Black-Briar wants her rival's mead business ruined. Meet Mallus Maccius, sabotage the Honningbrew Meadery and bring the promissory note back. Rewards an enchanted weapon and Mallus Maccius as a fence.
ThievesGuild_Quest04	|Quest Giver: - Brynjolf (Mercer Frey takes over).\nLocation: - Winking Skeever (Solitude), East Empire Company Warehouse and Brinewater Grotto.\nOverview: - Gulum-Ei is selling guild secrets. Retrieve Firebrand Wine from the Blue Palace, follow him at a distance and confront or negotiate with him. Rewards soul gems and upgraded Thieves Guild armour.
ThievesGuild_Quest05	|Quest Giver: - Mercer Frey.\nLocation: - Snow Veil Sanctum.\nOverview: - Meet Mercer outside Snow Veil Sanctum, enter with him, find Karliah and speak to her. Rewards Gallus's encoded journal and a Disarm word.
ThievesGuild_Quest06	|Quest Giver: - Karliah.\nLocation: - Understone Keep (Markarth), Frozen Hearth and the College of Winterhold.\nOverview: - Speak to Enthir, then to Calcelmo in Understone Keep. Copy the Falmer translation guide from the Dwemer museum and bring it to Enthir, then return to Karliah. Rewards the Nightingale Blade.
ThievesGuild_Quest07	|Quest Giver: - Karliah.\nLocation: - The Ragged Flagon, Riftweald Manor.\nOverview: - Meet Karliah and Brynjolf in the Ragged Flagon, then enter Riftweald Manor from the back to find the ledger and the evidence. Rewards Chillrend.
ThievesGuild_Quest08	|Quest Giver: - Brynjolf and Karliah.\nLocation: - Nightingale Hall.\nOverview: - Meet Karliah at the Shadow Stone outside Riften, enter Nightingale Hall, put on the Nightingale Armor and follow Karliah's instructions. Rewards Nightingale Armor. You must swear service to Nocturnal to continue the questline.
ThievesGuild_Quest09	|Quest Giver: - Brynjolf.\nLocation: - Irkngthand.\nOverview: - Travel to Irkngthand, locate and kill Mercer Frey, retrieve the Skeleton Key and escape. Rewards the Nightingale Bow, the Skeleton Key and the Falmer eyes.
ThievesGuild_Quest10	|Quest Giver: - Karliah.\nLocation: - Twilight Sepulcher.\nOverview: - Enter the Twilight Sepulcher, follow the Pilgrim's Path and unlock the Ebonmere with the Skeleton Key, then listen to Nocturnal and choose a Nightingale blessing. Completing the quest permanently removes the Skeleton Key, and the Pilgrim's Path is no longer accessible afterwards.
ThievesGuild_Quest11	|Quest Giver: - Brynjolf, once Darkness Returns is complete and the Guild has regained its influence in all four cities (the special jobs for Delvin in Whiterun, Markarth, Windhelm and Solitude).\nLocation: - The Ragged Flagon Cistern (Riften).\nOverview: - Speak to Brynjolf about becoming Guild Master, go to the centre of the Cistern for the ceremony and receive the Guild Master's Armor from Tonilia. Afterwards, check the tribute chest for loot.
ThievesGuild_Quest12	|Quest Giver: - Brynjolf.\nLocation: - The Ragged Flagon.\nOverview: - Speak to Vex and Delvin Mallory, then receive your Thieves Guild armour from Tonilia.
ThievesGuild_Quest13	|Quest Giver: - Starts when you find the first Unusual Gem.\nLocation: - Throughout Skyrim; Vex at the Ragged Flagon appraises.\nOverview: - Find any of the 24 Unusual Gems, join the Thieves Guild if you have not, have a gem appraised by Vex, then collect a full set of gems. Rewards Prowler's Profit.
ThievesGuild_Quest14	|Quest Giver: - The Unusual Gem you find.\nLocation: - Throughout Skyrim; Vex at the Ragged Flagon appraises.\nOverview: - Take the Unusual Gem to be identified. You need to be a full Thieves Guild member for Vex at the Ragged Flagon to appraise it.
ThievesGuild_Quest15	|Quest Giver: - Delvin Mallory.\nLocation: - Goldenglow Estate, Honningbrew Meadery, East Empire Company Warehouse (Solitude), Snow Veil Sanctum and other guild-quest sites.\nOverview: - Delvin wants trophies from earlier Thieves Guild quests: the Queen Bee Statue, Honningbrew Decanter, East Empire Shipping Map, Model Ship, Dwemer Puzzle Cube, Bust of the Gray Fox and the Left Eye of the Falmer. Rewards levelled gold.
ThievesGuild_Quest16	|Quest Giver: - Tonilia.\nLocation: - The Ragged Flagon, Markarth, Whiterun and the road between.\nOverview: - Deliver moon sugar to Ri'saad's caravan and return to Tonilia. Requires finishing three special reputation quests first. Rewards levelled gold and Atahbah, Zaynabi and Ma'jhad as fences.
ThievesGuild_Quest17	|Quest Giver: - Vekel the Man.\nLocation: - The Ragged Flagon and Yngvild.\nOverview: - Travel to Yngvild, collect four journals and return to Vekel. Rewards a levelled one-handed enchanted weapon.
ThievesGuild_Quest18	|Quest Giver: - Delvin Mallory (after five jobs in Whiterun).\nLocation: - Riften and Whiterun.\nOverview: - Talk to Olfrid Battle-Born in Whiterun, steal an incriminating letter, forge the prison registry and tell Olfrid it is done. Rewards levelled jewellery and an improved Thieves Guild.
ThievesGuild_Quest19	|Quest Giver: - Delvin Mallory (after five jobs in Markarth).\nLocation: - Riften, Markarth, Silver-Blood Inn and Pinewatch.\nOverview: - Talk to Endon in Markarth, enter Pinewatch from the basement, take the key from Rigel Strong-Arm at the Bandit's Sanctuary and open the room. Rewards enchanted armour, an improved guild and Endon as a fence.
ThievesGuild_Quest20	|Quest Giver: - Delvin Mallory (after five jobs in Windhelm).\nLocation: - Riften, Windhelm and Uttering Hills Cave.\nOverview: - Get the details from Torsten Cruel-Sea, speak to Niranye, recover Fjotli's silver locket from Uttering Hills Cave and return it. Rewards a levelled item, an improved guild and Niranye as a fence.
ThievesGuild_Quest21	|Quest Giver: - Delvin Mallory (after five jobs in Solitude).\nLocation: - Riften, Solitude and the Dainty Sload.\nOverview: - Learn the details from Erikur, get Balmora Blue from Sabine Nytte, plant it at the Dainty Sload and report back to Erikur. Rewards a random spell tome and an improved guild.
ThievesGuild_Quest22	|Quest Giver: - Delvin Mallory.\nLocation: - The Ragged Flagon and a major city.\nOverview: - Steal 500 gold's worth of goods in the target city and return to Delvin for levelled gold.
ThievesGuild_Quest23	|Quest Giver: - Vex.\nLocation: - The Ragged Flagon and a target house.\nOverview: - Steal the item Vex names from a house and return it for levelled gold. It fails if you are jailed or if one of the house's occupants dies while it is active.
ThievesGuild_Quest24	|Quest Giver: - Delvin Mallory.\nLocation: - The Ragged Flagon and a target's location.\nOverview: - Pickpocket the required items from the target and return to Delvin for levelled gold. It fails if you are jailed or if you kill the target.
ThievesGuild_Quest25	|Quest Giver: - Vex.\nLocation: - The Ragged Flagon and a target store.\nOverview: - Enter the targeted store, break into its strongbox and return the item for levelled gold. It fails if you are jailed, if someone in the store dies, or if you complete No One Escapes Cidhna Mine while a Markarth heist is active.
ThievesGuild_Quest26	|Quest Giver: - Delvin Mallory.\nLocation: - The Ragged Flagon and a target store.\nOverview: - Enter the requested store, alter its ledger and report back for levelled gold. It fails if you are jailed or anyone in the store dies.
ThievesGuild_Quest27	|Quest Giver: - Vex.\nLocation: - The Ragged Flagon and a target house.\nOverview: - Place the evidence in the designated chest in the targeted house and report back for levelled gold. It fails if one of the house's occupants dies while it is active.
ThievesGuild_Quest28	|Quest Giver: - Vex.\nLocation: - The Ragged Flagon and a target house.\nOverview: - Enter the targeted house, steal the items Vex names and return them for levelled gold. It fails if you are jailed or if one of the occupants dies.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Dawnguard (radiant quests)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Dawnguard_Quest00	|Quest Giver: - Sorine Jurard.\nLocation: - Fort Dawnguard and Ruunvald Excavation.\nOverview: - Speak to Isran, then travel to Ruunvald Excavation to find Florentius Baenius. Rewards the Staff of Ruunvald and a Master trainer in Restoration.\nMissable: - Dawnguard side only.
Dawnguard_Quest01	|Quest Giver: - Sorine Jurard.\nLocation: - Fort Dawnguard and a random location.\nOverview: - Travel to the marked location, retrieve the requested Dwemer schematics and return them to Sorine. Rewards a levelled enchanted item and lets you craft and buy crossbow upgrades and bolts.\nMissable: - Dawnguard side only.
Dawnguard_Quest02	|Quest Giver: - Gunmar.\nLocation: - Fort Dawnguard and a random vampire lair.\nOverview: - Kill the boss of a vampire lair and report back to Gunmar for a levelled enchanted item.\nMissable: - Dawnguard side only.
Dawnguard_Quest03	|Quest Giver: - Gunmar.\nLocation: - Fort Dawnguard and a random city or town.\nOverview: - A vampire is hiding as a travelling bard, pilgrim or visiting advisor. Find and kill the target, then report back for a levelled enchanted item.\nMissable: - Dawnguard side only.
Dawnguard_Quest04	|Quest Giver: - Gunmar.\nLocation: - Fort Dawnguard, a random city and a bandit camp or warlock lair.\nOverview: - Learn where a vampire is hiding, destroy it at its hideout and report back to Gunmar for a levelled enchanted item.\nMissable: - Dawnguard side only.
Dawnguard_Quest05	|Quest Giver: - Isran.\nLocation: - Fort Dawnguard and a random hold.\nOverview: - Warn the Jarl of a vampire threat, find evidence and kill the visiting advisor (or do it discreetly), then report to Isran for a levelled enchanted item.\nMissable: - Dawnguard side only.
Dawnguard_Quest06	|Quest Giver: - Florentius Baenius.\nLocation: - Fort Dawnguard and a random dungeon.\nOverview: - Retrieve the artefact Florentius asks for and return it. Rewards the Dawnguard Rune Hammer, Shield or Axe.\nMissable: - Dawnguard side only.
Dawnguard_Quest07	|Quest Giver: - Gunmar.\nLocation: - Fort Dawnguard and a random bandit camp or warlock lair.\nOverview: - Destroy a vampire before it turns its allies into vampires, then report back for a levelled enchanted item.\nMissable: - Dawnguard side only.
Dawnguard_Quest08	|Quest Giver: - Florentius Baenius.\nLocation: - Fort Dawnguard and a random bandit camp or warlock lair.\nOverview: - Rescue a kidnapped victim from vampires and report back to Florentius for a levelled enchanted item.\nMissable: - Dawnguard side only.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Volkihar vampires (radiant quests)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Vampires_Quest00	|Quest Giver: - Feran Sadri.\nLocation: - Castle Volkihar and a random location.\nOverview: - Retrieve both Amulets of Night Power and return them. Rewards the Amulets of the Gargoyle and Bats and three Potions of Blood.\nMissable: - Volkihar side only.
Vampires_Quest01	|Quest Giver: - Garan Marethi or Fura Bloodmouth.\nLocation: - Dayspring Canyon and Fort Dawnguard.\nOverview: - Kill the Dawnguard leaders at Fort Dawnguard and report back. Rewards three Potions of Blood or a levelled item.\nMissable: - Volkihar side only.
Vampires_Quest02	|Quest Giver: - Vingalmo.\nLocation: - Castle Volkihar and your spouse's home.\nOverview: - Needs a spouse. Use Vampire's Seduction on your spouse, feed on them and return to Vingalmo for three Potions of Blood or a levelled item.\nMissable: - Volkihar side only; requires a spouse.
Vampires_Quest03	|Quest Giver: - Feran Sadri.\nLocation: - Castle Volkihar and random locations.\nOverview: - Find the two Rings of Blood Magic and report back. Rewards the Ring of the Erudite, Ring of the Beast and three Potions of Blood.\nMissable: - Volkihar side only.
Vampires_Quest04	|Quest Giver: - Feran Sadri.\nLocation: - Castle Volkihar and a location with ancient remains.\nOverview: - Retrieve the remains of an ancient vampire and bring them to Feran. Rewards Bloodstone Chalice upgrades and three Potions of Blood.\nMissable: - Volkihar side only.
Vampires_Quest05	|Quest Giver: - Fura Bloodmouth or Garan Marethi.\nLocation: - Castle Volkihar and a random vampire lair.\nOverview: - Kill the boss vampire in its lair and report back. Rewards three Potions of Blood or a levelled enchanted item.\nMissable: - Volkihar side only.
Vampires_Quest06	|Quest Giver: - Feran Sadri.\nLocation: - Castle Volkihar and a random city.\nOverview: - Read an incriminating letter to find the city of the victim, then kill them. Making it a public kill wearing Dawnguard armour, or choosing a high-profile victim, gives bonuses.\nMissable: - Volkihar side only.
Vampires_Quest07	|Quest Giver: - Vingalmo.\nLocation: - Castle Volkihar and a specified location.\nOverview: - Turn the target into a vampire and report back to Vingalmo. Rewards three Potions of Blood or an enchanted item, and access to a coffin in the target's home.\nMissable: - Volkihar side only.
Vampires_Quest08	|Quest Giver: - Fura Bloodmouth or Garan Marethi.\nLocation: - Castle Volkihar and a random bandit camp or warlock lair.\nOverview: - Kill a feral-blooded vampire before it turns its allies and return to the quest giver. Rewards three Potions of Blood or a levelled enchanted item.\nMissable: - Volkihar side only.
Vampires_Quest09	|Quest Giver: - Fura Bloodmouth or Garan Marethi.\nLocation: - Castle Volkihar and the road.\nOverview: - Kill a travelling bard, merchant or pilgrim (a discreet kill is optional) and return to the quest giver. Rewards three Potions of Blood or a levelled item.\nMissable: - Volkihar side only.

-- Dungeons

Dungeons_Quest00		|Quest Giver: - Medresi Dran, inside Angarvunde.\nLocation: - Angarvunde.\nOverview: - Enter Angarvunde and speak to Medresi Dran, kill three draugr in the main chamber and follow her through the catacombs to open the gate into the ruins, then retrieve the treasure she is after.
Dungeons_Quest01		|Quest Giver: - Starts automatically on entering Ansilvund.\nLocation: - Ansilvund.\nOverview: - Make your way through the Nordic ruin of Ansilvund and kill Lu'ah Al-Skaven, the necromancer who has taken up residence.
Dungeons_Quest02		|Quest Giver: - Melka, imprisoned in Blind Cliff Cave.\nLocation: - Blind Cliff Cave (the Reach).\nOverview: - Free Melka, protect her from the Forsworn as you travel through the tower, and kill the hagraven Petra.
Dungeons_Quest03		|Quest Giver: - Illia, at Darklight Tower.\nLocation: - Darklight Tower.\nOverview: - Help Illia reach the top of Darklight Tower and defeat Silvia, who is waiting there.
Dungeons_Quest04		|Quest Giver: - Captain Valmir.\nLocation: - Forelhost.\nOverview: - Speak to Captain Valmir to begin, enter the ruins of Forelhost, optionally find Skorm Snow-Strider's journal and make your way through the first zone into the crypt, where you take on the Dragon Cult and claim the mask of the dragon priest Rahgot.
Dungeons_Quest05		|Quest Giver: - Starts automatically on entering Frostflow Lighthouse.\nLocation: - Frostflow Lighthouse and Frostflow Abyss.\nOverview: - Read the family's journals in the lighthouse, find the cellar key in the burial urn on the mantel and explore the Abyss below.\nNOTE: It is recommended to complete this quest as soon as possible.
Dungeons_Quest06		|Quest Giver: - None; found by exploring Frostmere Crypt.\nLocation: - Frostmere Crypt.\nOverview: - Find Frostmere Crypt, learn about the theft of the Pale Lady's belongings and fight deeper into the crypt to banish the Pale Lady one way or another.
Dungeons_Quest07		|Quest Giver: - Anska, inside High Gate Ruins.\nLocation: - High Gate Ruins.\nOverview: - Agree to help Anska, protect her as you fight through the ruins, defeat Vokun and retrieve her scroll.
Dungeons_Quest08		|Quest Giver: - Golldir, outside Hillgrund's Tomb.\nLocation: - Whiterun Hold, Hillgrund's Tomb.\nOverview: - Go with Golldir to rescue his aunt Agna from the necromancer Vals Veran. Find a way into the room where Vals is hiding and kill him.
Dungeons_Quest09		|Quest Giver: - Salma, outside Ironbind Barrow.\nLocation: - Ironbind Barrow.\nOverview: - Escort Salma and Beem-Ja through the ruins until the fight with Warlord Gathrik, then kill Beem-Ja and speak with Salma.
Dungeons_Quest10		|Quest Giver: - None; found by exploring Liar's Retreat.\nLocation: - Liar's Retreat.\nOverview: - Investigate what happened at Liar's Retreat, find the Falmer nest, claim Rahd's Longhammer and take the blame for the Falmer attack.
Dungeons_Quest11		|Quest Giver: - Christer, in Mistwatch North Tower.\nLocation: - Mistwatch.\nOverview: - Deal with the bandits outside, drop the drawbridge and enter the north tower. Agree to help Christer find his kidnapped wife and proceed through the fort.
Dungeons_Quest12		|Quest Giver: - Telrav, on the road east of Nilheim.\nLocation: - Road east of Nilheim and his camp.\nOverview: - Escort Telrav to his camp in Nilheim, then kill him and his men.
Dungeons_Quest13		|Quest Giver: - None; found by exploring Ragnvald.\nLocation: - Ragnvald.\nOverview: - Find the sarcophagus, retrieve Saerek's and Torsten's skull keys, open it and kill Otar the Mad.
Dungeons_Quest14		|Quest Giver: - Reading The Legend of Red Eagle.\nLocation: - Red Eagle Redoubt, Sundered Towers and Rebel's Cairn.\nOverview: - Clear Red Eagle Redoubt, climb Sundered Towers, kill the Forsworn leader and retrieve Red Eagle's Fury, then take the sword to Rebel's Cairn.
Dungeons_Quest15		|Quest Giver: - None; found by exploring Robber's Gorge.\nLocation: - Robber's Gorge.\nOverview: - Investigate for a secret trapdoor, find the journal in Robber's Cove and follow the clues to the bandit leader's hidden treasure.
Dungeons_Quest16		|Quest Giver: - Selveni Nethri, trapped in Southfringe Sanctum.\nLocation: - Southfringe Sanctum.\nOverview: - Cut Selveni Nethri free from the webs and help her escape the cave.\nMissable: - The quest fails if Selveni Nethri dies.
Dungeons_Quest17		|Quest Giver: - Stalleo, outside Treva's Watch.\nLocation: - Treva's Watch.\nOverview: - Enter Treva's Watch through the secret tunnel, open the main gate and speak to Stalleo again.
Dungeons_Quest18		|Quest Giver: - Valdar, a ghost inside Valthume.\nLocation: - Valthume.\nOverview: - Collect the vessels from Hevnoraak's draugr minions and kill the dragon priest Hevnoraak.
Dungeons_Quest19		|Quest Giver: - None; found by exploring Volskygge.\nLocation: - Volskygge.\nOverview: - Fight through the ruin and defeat the dragon priest Volsung.
Dungeons_Quest20		|Quest Giver: - Reading Heddic's Volunruud Notes.\nLocation: - Volunruud.\nOverview: - Travel to Volunruud, locate the ceremonial weapons, open the Elder's Cairn and defeat Kvenel.
Dungeons_Quest21		|Quest Giver: - None; found by exploring Yngol Barrow.\nLocation: - Yngol Barrow.\nOverview: - Obtain a Coral Dragon Claw, solve the barrow's puzzle and escape.
Dungeons_Quest00_DQANM	|Quest Giver: - Medresi Dran, inside Angarvunde.\nLocation: - Angarvunde.\nOverview: - Enter Angarvunde and speak to Medresi Dran, kill three draugr in the main chamber and follow her through the catacombs to open the gate into the ruins, then retrieve the treasure she is after.

-- Dragonborn: miscellaneous quests
----------------------------------------------------------------------------
Misc_DB_Quest00	|Quest Giver: - Reading the book Deathbrand.\nLocation: - Haknir's Shoal and Gyldenhul Barrow (Solstheim).\nOverview: - Follow the treasure map to find four ancient chests holding the pieces of Deathbrand armour, then explore Gyldenhul Barrow and defeat Haknir Death-Brand and his crew. Rewards the Deathbrand armour, Bloodscythe and Soulrender, and a minimum of 6,400 gold.
Misc_DB_Quest01	|Quest Giver: - The Ebony Warrior, who approaches you once you are level 80 and enter Whiterun, Riften, Windhelm, Markarth or Solitude.\nLocation: - One of those cities and Last Vigil (Solstheim).\nOverview: - Talk to the Ebony Warrior, then meet him at the Last Vigil on Solstheim and defeat him. Rewards his heavily enchanted ebony equipment and valuable gems.
Misc_DB_Quest02	|Quest Giver: - None; discovered in the world.\nLocation: - Hrodulf's House (Solstheim).\nOverview: - Investigate the house, fight the reavers in the cellar, uncover the secret behind the bookshelf and find out what happened to Hrodulf and Bjornolfr.
Misc_DB_Quest03	|Quest Giver: - None; discovered in the world.\nLocation: - Kagrumez, plus any two of Fahlbtharz, Revus Sarvani's camp near Tel Mithryn and Nchardak.\nOverview: - Gather two Kagrumez Resonance Gems, kill the reavers inside Kagrumez, find the third gem on their leader, place them on the pedestal in three patterns and defeat the waves of enemies. Rewards a Steadfast Dwarven Spider and Sphere follower and the Dwarven Black Bow of Fate.
Misc_DB_Quest04	|Quest Giver: - None; discovered in the world.\nLocation: - Glacial Cave and Castle Karstaag Ruins (Solstheim).\nOverview: - Take Karstaag's skull from the Glacial Cave to Castle Karstaag, either through the caverns or the locked front door, and place it to summon him. Rewards the Summon Karstaag power.
Misc_DB_Quest05	|Quest Giver: - Ralis Sedarys, at Kolbjorn Barrow (or by reading Ahzidal's Descent).\nLocation: - Kolbjorn Barrow (Solstheim).\nOverview: - Ralis wants funding to excavate the barrow. Pay 1,000 gold, wait for his message and then return to defeat what is inside. Rewards the Relics of Ahzidal, a Cyclone word and Ralis as a follower if spared.\nMissable: - Whether Ralis lives depends on your choice at the end; killing him loses the follower.
Misc_DB_Quest06	|Quest Giver: - Read the Black Book Untold Legends.\nLocation: - Benkongerike Great Hall and Apocrypha.\nOverview: - Read the book, cross Apocrypha, learn the book's hidden knowledge and choose one reward: Bardic Knowledge, Black Market or Secret Servant.\nMissable: - You can only choose one reward.
Misc_DB_Quest07	|Quest Giver: - Read the Black Book The Winds of Change.\nLocation: - Raven Rock Mine and Apocrypha.\nOverview: - Read the book, cross Apocrypha and choose one reward: Companion's Insight, Lover's Insight or Scholar's Insight.\nMissable: - You can only choose one reward.
Misc_DB_Quest08	|Quest Giver: - Read the Black Book The Sallow Regent.\nLocation: - White Ridge Barrow and Apocrypha.\nOverview: - Read the book, travel through Apocrypha and choose one reward: Seeker of Might, Seeker of Shadows or Seeker of Sorcery.\nMissable: - You can only choose one reward.
Misc_DB_Quest09	|Quest Giver: - Read the Black Book Filament and Filigree.\nLocation: - Kolbjorn Barrow and Apocrypha.\nOverview: - Read the book, cross Apocrypha and choose one reward: Secret of Arcana, Secret of Protection or Secret of Strength.\nMissable: - You can only choose one reward.
Misc_DB_Quest10	|Quest Giver: - Read the Black Book The Hidden Twilight.\nLocation: - Tel Mithryn and Apocrypha.\nOverview: - Read the book, cross Apocrypha and choose one reward: Mora's Agony, Mora's Boon or Mora's Grasp.\nMissable: - You can only choose one reward.

Misc_DG_Quest01	|Quest Giver: - Urag gro-Shub.\nLocation: - The Forgotten Vale and the College of Winterhold.\nOverview: - Find an Ancient Falmer Tome in the Forgotten Vale and bring it to Urag gro-Shub for 1,000 gold per book.
Misc_DG_Quest02	|Quest Giver: - The Soul of Jiub.\nLocation: - The Soul Cairn.\nOverview: - Collect all ten pages of Jiub's Opus scattered across the Soul Cairn and return them to Jiub. Rewards the Locket of Saint Jiub and Saint Jiub's Opus.
Misc_DG_Quest03	|Quest Giver: - Read The Aetherium Wars, enter Arkngthamz, or find an Aetherium Shard.\nLocation: - Arkngthamz, Deep Folk Crossing, Raldbthar, Dwarven Storeroom and the Ruins of Bthalft.\nOverview: - Reach the summit of Arkngthamz and solve its tonal lock, speak with the ghost Katria, find the four Aetherium Shards, locate the Aetherium Forge in the Ruins of Bthalft and craft one item. Optionally take the unique bow Zephyr in Arkngthamz. Rewards the Aetherial Crown, Shield or Staff.\nMissable: - You can only forge one of the three items.\nNOTE: It is recommended to complete this quest as soon as possible and after completing 'Mourning Never Comes'.
Misc_DG_Quest04	|Quest Giver: - A distraught soul in the Soul Cairn.\nLocation: - The Soul Cairn.\nOverview: - Find Arvak's skull and return it to the soul. Rewards the Summon Arvak spell.
