Side_SK_Quest04	|Quest Giver: - A member of an Orc stronghold.\nLocation: - Any Orc stronghold.\nOverview: - Speak to a member of the stronghold and its guard, then retrieve the Forgemaster's Fingers.\nNOTE: This quest should be completed before completing any of the Blood-Kin quests, and it is not available if you are playing as an Orc or have helped any Orcs in game.
Side_SK_Quest05	|Quest Giver: - Grosta.\nLocation: - Heartwood Mill and Broken Helm Hollow.\nOverview: - Find Grosta's missing husband Leifnarr in Broken Helm Hollow and return to Grosta.\nMissable: - Killing Grosta fails the quest and removes it from the journal.
Side_SK_Quest06	|Quest Giver: - Arngeir at High Hrothgar.\nLocation: - High Hrothgar and word walls around Skyrim.\nOverview: - Arngeir points you to a word wall to learn a Word of Power. This quest can be repeated.
Side_SK_Quest07	|Quest Giver: - Ainethach or Atar.\nLocation: - Karthwasten.\nOverview: - Speak with Ainethach and Atar about the shut-down mine, then convince Ainethach to sell or Atar to leave.\nNOTE: Do not start this quest until 'The Forgemaster's Fingers' has been started.
Side_SK_Quest08	|Quest Giver: - Pavo Attius or Skaggi Scar-Face.\nLocation: - Left Hand Mine and Kolskeggr Mine.\nOverview: - Clear the Forsworn out of Kolskeggr Mine and claim your reward.\nNOTE: Do not start this quest until 'The Forgemaster's Fingers' has been started.
Side_SK_Quest09	|Quest Giver: - Dravynea the Stoneweaver.\nLocation: - Kynesgrove.\nOverview: - Obtain a sample of frost salts and bring it to Dravynea for your reward.
Side_SK_Quest10	|Quest Giver: - Atub.\nLocation: - Largashbur, Fallowstone Cave and Giant's Grove.\nOverview: - Help the Orcs of Largashbur repel a giant attack, then bring Atub a bowl of troll fat and a Daedra heart to lift the curse.\nNOTE: Do not start this quest until 'The Forgemaster's Fingers' has been started.
Side_SK_Quest11	|Quest Giver: - Dravin Llanith.\nLocation: - Merryfair Farm and the Ratway (Riften).\nOverview: - Find Dravin's bow in the Ratway and return it to him.
Side_SK_Quest12	|Quest Giver: - Valdr, outside Moss Mother Cavern.\nLocation: - Moss Mother Cavern.\nOverview: - Heal Valdr or give him healing items, then help him clear the spriggans out of the cavern.
Side_SK_Quest13	|Quest Giver: - Eydis (after the ghost appears while you sleep at the inn).\nLocation: - Old Hroldan Inn and a random dungeon.\nOverview: - Sleep at the inn, speak to the ghost and Eydis, recover Hjalti's sword from a random dungeon and return it for free training.
Side_SK_Quest14	|Quest Giver: - Reading the book Boethiah's Proving, or automatically on visiting the Sacellum of Boethiah.\nLocation: - Sacellum of Boethiah and Knifepoint Ridge.\nOverview: - Speak to the Priestess of Boethiah and lead someone who follows you to the shrine, where they are trapped. Kill them, then kill all the cult members and face Boethiah's challenge. Anyone willing to follow you will do.
Side_SK_Quest15	|Quest Giver: - Rogatus Salvius.\nLocation: - Salvius Farmhouse and Old Hroldan Inn.\nOverview: - Deliver Rogatus's letter to his son Leontius Salvius at the Old Hroldan Inn.
Side_SK_Quest16	|Quest Giver: - Avrusa Sarethi.\nLocation: - Sarethi Farm (Eastmarch).\nOverview: - Collect 20 jazbay grapes and return them to Avrusa.
Side_SK_Quest17	|Quest Giver: - Septimus Signus, or reading Ruminations on the Elder Scrolls.\nLocation: - Septimus Signus's Outpost, Alftand, Blackreach and Tower of Mzark.\nOverview: - Find the Elder Scroll in Blackreach, fill the Blank Lexicon, harvest blood from several races and deliver the Lexicon to Septimus. Rewards the Oghma Infinium.\nMissable: - After opening the cube, leaving the outpost and letting the cell respawn permanently closes the Dwemer puzzle door and can lock the Oghma Infinium inside.
Side_SK_Quest18	|Quest Giver: - Aranea Ienith.\nLocation: - Shrine of Azura, Ilinalta's Deep and Azura's Star.\nOverview: - Go to the Shrine of Azura, speak to Nelacar in Winterhold, claim the Broken Star in Ilinalta's Deep and give it to Aranea or Nelacar, then cleanse it from within.

Radi_SK_Quest25	|Quest Giver: - Vigdis Salvius, at Salvius Farmhouse.\nLocation: - Salvius Farmhouse.\nOverview: - Harvest crops for Vigdis and get paid.
Radi_SK_Quest26	|Quest Giver: - Annekke Crag-Jumper, in Darkwater Crossing.\nLocation: - Darkwater Crossing and a bandit lair.\nOverview: - Kill the bandit leader at the named lair and return for levelled gold and/or a skill increase. You may gain a follower.
Radi_SK_Quest27	|Quest Giver: - Dushnamub, in Gloombound Mine.\nLocation: - Gloombound Mine.\nOverview: - Mine ore for Dushnamub and get paid.
Radi_SK_Quest28	|Quest Giver: - Gestur Rockbreaker, in Rockwallow Mine.\nLocation: - Rockwallow Mine.\nOverview: - Mine ore for Gestur and get paid.
Radi_SK_Quest29	|Quest Giver: - Gharol, in Dushnikh Mine.\nLocation: - Dushnikh Mine.\nOverview: - Mine ore for Gharol and get paid.
Radi_SK_Quest30	|Quest Giver: - Grogmar gro-Burzag, in Redbelly Mine.\nLocation: - Redbelly Mine.\nOverview: - Mine ore for Grogmar and get paid.
Radi_SK_Quest31	|Quest Giver: - Kjeld, in Steamscorch Mine.\nLocation: - Steamscorch Mine.\nOverview: - Mine ore for Kjeld and get paid.
Radi_SK_Quest32	|Quest Giver: - Pavo Attius, in Kolskeggr Mine.\nLocation: - Kolskeggr Mine.\nOverview: - Mine ore for Pavo and get paid.
Radi_SK_Quest33	|Quest Giver: - Perth, in Soljund's Sinkhole.\nLocation: - Soljund's Sinkhole.\nOverview: - Mine ore for Perth and get paid.
Radi_SK_Quest34	|Quest Giver: - Shuftharz, in Mor Khazgur Mine.\nLocation: - Mor Khazgur Mine.\nOverview: - Mine ore for Shuftharz and get paid.
Radi_SK_Quest35	|Quest Giver: - Skaggi Scar-Face, in Left Hand Mine.\nLocation: - Left Hand Mine.\nOverview: - Mine ore for Skaggi and get paid.
Radi_SK_Quest36	|Quest Giver: - Thorgar, in Whistling Mine.\nLocation: - Whistling Mine.\nOverview: - Mine ore for Thorgar and get paid.
Radi_SK_Quest37	|Quest Giver: - Verner Rock-Chucker, in Goldenrock Mine.\nLocation: - Goldenrock Mine.\nOverview: - Mine ore for Verner and get paid.
Radi_SK_Quest38	|Quest Giver: - Chief Burguk, in Dushnikh Yal.\nLocation: - Dushnikh Yal.\nOverview: - Challenge Burguk to a brawl to prove your worth, win, and speak to him again. Pays 100 gold.
Radi_SK_Quest39	|Quest Giver: - Chief Larak, in Mor Khazgur.\nLocation: - Mor Khazgur.\nOverview: - Challenge Larak to a brawl to prove your worth, win, and speak to him again. Pays 100 gold.
Radi_SK_Quest40	|Quest Giver: - Chief Mauhulakh, in Narzulbur.\nLocation: - Narzulbur.\nOverview: - Challenge Mauhulakh to a brawl to prove your worth, win, and speak to him again. Pays 100 gold.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Legacy of the Dragonborn: main quests
----------------------------------------------------------------------------
LOTD_Main_Quest00	|Quest Giver: - Auryen Morellus, after you read a "Seeking Treasure Hunters" notice (pinned up in inns all over Skyrim, such as the Winking Skeever and the Bannered Mare) or the letter Auryen sends you after you sell one of the relics he is looking for.\nLocation: - Dragonborn Gallery (Solitude).\nOverview: - Speak to Auryen at the museum about the relic hunter position. To prove yourself he asks for three relics: the Sixth House Bell Hammer from Broken Helm Hollow, Denstagmer's Ring from Silent Moons Camp and a Jade Warrior statue hidden somewhere in the Reach. Deliver all three and he takes you on to help build the museum.\nNOTE: This is the 'Vanilla' starting quest.
LOTD_Main_Quest01	|Quest Giver: - Automatic, when you start a new game with the Solitude docks start in Alternate Start - Live Another Life and answer yes when you are asked whether you have come for the museum (offered in the first 3 days only).\nLocation: - Dragonborn Gallery (Solitude), Helgen, Bleak Falls Barrow and Silent Moons Camp.\nOverview: - You arrive in Skyrim to help Auryen Morellus build his new museum. Read his letter, meet him at the museum beside the Blue Palace and review his notes: collect some Nordic urns from Borgoth in Helgen (destroyed when the town is attacked), then investigate Bleak Falls Barrow and Silent Moons Camp before setting out on your own.\nMissable: - Only on a new game: the prompt appears in the first 3 days and only if An Interesting Prospect has not started.\nNOTE: This is the 'Live Another Life' starting quest.
LOTD_Main_Quest02	|Quest Giver: - Automatic, when you choose "I am the Guild Master for the Explorers Society" at the Mara statue in Alternate Start - Live Another Life (needs Relic Hunter - Guildmaster Start).\nLocation: - Akaviri Outpost.\nOverview: - You wake up late at an excavation of an Akaviri ruin, already Guild Master of the Explorers Society with its members recruited. Gather your explorer tools and gear, explore the ruin with Arginal once the team clears the cave-in, open the inner sanctum, defeat the ghost of General Xile and show the chakram Drakensang to Karl the Excavator. Farlan can give you a ride to Whiterun.\nMissable: - Only on a new game, through the Live Another Life guild master start.\nNOTE: This is the 'Guild Master' starting quest.
LOTD_Main_Quest03	|Quest Giver: - Automatic, a few days after Akaviri Rising (needs Relic Hunter - Guildmaster Start).\nLocation: - Dragonborn Gallery (Solitude).\nOverview: - Karl the Excavator tells you that your old colleague Auryen Morellus of Gwylim University is in Skyrim. Meet him at the museum, take his tour, and put the Akaviri relic you found on display. This replaces the usual An Interesting Prospect for the guild master start.
LOTD_Main_Quest04	|Quest Giver: - Read Auryen's Initial Notes, which Auryen gives you at the end of An Interesting Prospect on the Relic Hunter - Guildmaster Start.\nLocation: - Helgen, Bleak Falls Barrow and Silent Moons Camp.\nOverview: - Auryen's notes ask you to collect some rare Nordic urns from Borgoth, a merchant in Helgen (they are destroyed when the town is attacked), then to investigate Bleak Falls Barrow and Silent Moons Camp before setting out on your own.
LOTD_Main_Quest05	|Quest Giver: - Brother Ikard, a priest of Arkay. Starts automatically when you arrive at the museum after An Interesting Prospect, once you have 300 items on display.\nLocation: - Dragonborn Gallery (Solitude).\nOverview: - Auryen has closed the museum because of a ghostly disturbance. Investigate inside with Brother Ikard, piece together the story from the journals of Niles Macnarian, live through a nightmare in which the museum burns, and put an end to the haunting.
LOTD_Main_Quest06	|Quest Giver: - Avram Shazir. Starts automatically when you arrive at the museum after Night at the Museum, once you have 400 items on display.\nLocation: - Dragonborn Gallery (Solitude), Windcaller Pass, the road west to Hammerfell and Engelmann's Rest.\nOverview: - The museum has been robbed by people from Avram's past. With Avram, recover the first relics in Windcaller Pass, stop Jelal's caravan before it leaves Skyrim and confront Jelal at Engelmann's Rest; he turns out to be Avram's brother. Return the relics to Auryen, and Avram later thanks you with his father's sword.\nNOTE: If 'Night at the Museum' is currently ongoing it will need to be completed before this quest can start.
LOTD_Main_Quest07	|Quest Giver: - Byron, a man fleeing Morag Tong assassins. Starts automatically after The Way of the Voice, once you have 550 items on display and have collected more than 10 of the museum's display rewards.\nLocation: - Wherever Byron finds you; leads to High Hrothgar, Fort Pale Pass, Dushnikh Yal, Raven's Rest, Windhelm and Sancre Tor.\nOverview: - Byron gives you a shard of the Amulet of Kings. Seek out its other guardians, Argus, Ezra and Ulgarg, and gather the shards and the setting, along with the shield of Reman Cyrodiil. Argus and Ezra turn on you. Use the Ayleid Waystone to reach Sancre Tor, defeat the Underking, then fetch Wulfharth's boots, the Lord's Mail and Tiber Septim's helm for the Herald of Akatosh and reform the Amulet of Kings.\nNOTE: The main quest 'The Way of the Voice' has to be completed.
LOTD_Main_Quest08	|Quest Giver: - Auryen Morellus, after Shattered Legacy.\nLocation: - Dragonborn Gallery (Solitude).\nOverview: - Auryen has learnt that the Ayleid Waystone travels through a pocket realm of Oblivion, the Ayleid Crossroads. Use the attunement scroll on the Waystone amulet, then wear it to be taken to the Crossroads.
LOTD_Main_Quest09	|Quest Giver: - Auryen Morellus, after A Room with a View, once you are level 18 and have 75 items on display.\nLocation: - Dragonborn Gallery and the Explorers Society Guildhouse (Solitude), or Elsweyr with Moonpath to Elsweyr.\nOverview: - Rakis, a Khajiit in Elsweyr, wants to donate the Staff of Indarys to the museum. Meet him on the Guildhouse patio, take the staff and kill the Thalmor assassin who tries to steal it. With Moonpath to Elsweyr and its Legacy patch, Auryen instead sends you to the Khajiit caravan in Falkreath to travel the Moonpath to Elsweyr, where Rakis hands you the staff in person.\nNOTE: Minimum level of 18 required.
LOTD_Main_Quest10	|Quest Giver: - Read a book about the Atmoran prison Deepholme, or arrive at its ruin after Shadows of One's Past.\nLocation: - Deepholme, on a small island in the northern Sea of Ghosts.\nOverview: - Get into the prison, find the totemic key that opens the sealed vault and kill the Elven lich locked inside. Ask Auryen about it; for 10,000 gold the explorers turn Deepholme into a secret vault where you can keep relics while replicas stay on display.
LOTD_Main_Quest11	|Quest Giver: - Auryen Morellus.\nLocation: - Dragonborn Gallery (Solitude).\nOverview: - Auryen gives you a lead on a rare artefact somewhere in or around a location. Find it and bring it back for him to put on display, for a reward. If you can't find it, he has other leads. Repeatable.
LOTD_Main_Quest12	|Quest Giver: - Use the Research Station in the museum library.\nLocation: - Dragonborn Gallery (Solitude).\nOverview: - Spend research points to find where an artefact or book is, then go to that area and find it. Repeatable.\nNOTE: Researching for a new item before completing the previous one will forfeit the points spent to research it.
LOTD_Main_Quest13	|Quest Giver: - Automatic, on entering the Hall of Heroes after Night at the Museum, Shadows of One's Past, A Path to the Heavens and The Vaults of Deepholme, once you have 750 items on display, including a Black Book and at least 10 Daedric Gallery items.\nLocation: - Dragonborn Gallery (Solitude).\nOverview: - Vigilants of Stendarr arrive and demand the museum's Daedric relics. Talk them down with your deeds, hand over the originals or replicas made at the replica station, win each Vigilant over privately (Astrian wants the Mythic Dawn Commentaries, Tylende a good weapon, and so on), quietly arrange "accidents", or fight them.
LOTD_Main_Quest14	|Quest Giver: - Automatic, some time after The Price of Vigilants if the Vigilants left the museum.\nLocation: - Skyrim's roads, then Stendarr's Refuge inside Stendarr's Beacon.\nOverview: - The Daedric relics have corrupted Astrian's Vigilants. Fight off Tylende, Cindra, Burondis and Morgi when they attack, search them for a note pointing to their hidden fortress in Stendarr's Beacon, then kill Astrian and take back the relics.\nMissable: - It only happens if the Vigilants leave the museum. If you win every Vigilant over or kill them all in The Price of Vigilants, it never starts.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Legacy of the Dragonborn: expeditions
----------------------------------------------------------------------------
LOTD_Exp_Quest00	|Quest Giver: - Auryen Morellus, once you have 150 items on display.\nLocation: - Dragonborn Gallery (Solitude).\nOverview: - Auryen proposes founding the Explorers Society, with you as Guild Master and himself as Chief Librarian. Build the Guildhouse at the workbench he sets up behind the museum (Hjorunn at the Solitude mill sells you lumber at a discount), then show Auryen around and go over the guild charter.
LOTD_Exp_Quest01	|Quest Giver: - Read the Guild Master's journal on the desk inside the Guildhouse, after A Room with a View.\nLocation: - Explorers Society Guildhouse (Solitude).\nOverview: - Auryen gives you a list of possible members. Find and recruit Eriana, Professor Patero Marassi, Kyre Oldenson, Madras and Latoria to build up the Explorers Society.
LOTD_Exp_Quest02	|Quest Giver: - Professor Patero Marassi, after Shadows of One's Past and Digging Up Explorers, once you have reached the Western Watchtower dragon fight in Dragon Rising and have 450 items on display.\nLocation: - Windcaller Pass (north side of the Throat of the World).\nOverview: - Meet the excavation team at the pass, clear out the creatures inside and let the team dig through each blocked tunnel. Kill the two dragons in the clearing, recover a claw key, an amulet and a ring, track down the "creature" that steals the relics from Latoria, survive a gas trap and find the exit.
LOTD_Exp_Quest03	|Quest Giver: - Professor Patero Marassi, some days after The Excavation of Windcaller Pass, once the team is back and you have 600 items on display.\nLocation: - Ruins of Rkund (mountains south-west of Riften).\nOverview: - Use the survey tool to mark dig sites until the team breaks through into Rkund. Inside, find the three cog keys to open Karagas' Maze, reach Karagas' Tower and its machine, and bring the explorers back through the transport device.
LOTD_Exp_Quest04	|Quest Giver: - Automatic, on entering a town or settlement after Much Ado About Snow Elves and The Excavation of the Ruins of Rkund, once you have 750 items on display.\nLocation: - Starts wherever you are; leads to the caves beneath Fort Greenwall (the Rift).\nOverview: - The Snow Elf ghost from Calcelmo's quest appears again. Follow her to a hidden Snow Elf ruin in the caves beneath Fort Greenwall, then tell Professor Marassi about the find.
LOTD_Exp_Quest05	|Quest Giver: - Automatic, at the end of The Visage.\nLocation: - Ruins beneath Fort Greenwall, a Temple of Trinimac in south-west Skyrim, and the Glacial Crevice in Darkfall Passage.\nOverview: - Excavate the Snow Elf ruins under Fort Greenwall: open a Snow Elf chest, find the chalice for the shrine to Phynaster and recover a Falmer tome. A cave-in kills Professor Marassi and you name a new chief of archaeology. Translate the tome with Calcelmo's help, dig out the Temple of Trinimac, open it with the Spear of the Snow Prince and chase Tulrin Deathweaver to the Temple of the Venerable Ones, where you rebuild the Harmonic Touchstone, solve the chimes and defeat him.\nNOTE: In order to complete this quest, you will need access to the Glacial Crevice in the Forgotten Vale.
LOTD_Exp_Quest06	|Quest Giver: - Automatic, when you pick up the first icy shard during The Excavation of Windcaller Pass.\nLocation: - Windcaller Pass.\nOverview: - Show the shard to Auryen, who identifies it as a piece of the Icestaff of Hrormir. Gather all six shards, return to Auryen, then find the stone circle (the Coldforge) to reforge the staff.
LOTD_Exp_Quest07	|Quest Giver: - Automatic, when you find the Dwemer schematics in Karagas' Tower.\nLocation: - Ruins of Rkund, then Madras at the museum.\nOverview: - Show the schematics to Madras, then gather 75 Quarried Stone, 40 Dwemer Metal Ingots, 25 Sawn Logs and 5 Iron Fittings, help him with the build and give him a few days to finish the Planetarium.
LOTD_Exp_Quest08	|Quest Giver: - Automatic, when you read Malrus' Journal.\nLocation: - Silent Moons Camp (a copy is also in the Guildhouse).\nOverview: - Malrus' journal describes a codex sealed beneath the ruins. Activate the three keys he mentions, a Nordic Runestone, a Snow Elf Shrine and a Dwemer Monument, then return to Silent Moons Camp to retrieve Malrus' Codex.
LOTD_Exp_Quest09	|Quest Giver: - Automatic, when you read Kamahl's Map, left for you by Professor Marassi.\nLocation: - Across Skyrim.\nOverview: - Use the map to find six explorer relics: Schneider's Sextant, Sands' Torch, Deano's Bottomless Pack, Alvaro's Tools, Aleksey's Key and Luca's Pickaxe.\nNOTE: The relics and names of the explorers actually relate to members of the development team or key contributors to Legacy of the Dragonborn's development.
LOTD_Exp_Quest10	|Quest Giver: - Professor Patero Marassi (or Auryen if Marassi has died), after Under Saarthal.\nLocation: - A cliff south of Saarthal (Winterhold).\nOverview: - Gather 100 lumber, 40 stone blocks and 20 slabs of clay and build the Northern Field Station, a safehouse and supply stop for the explorers, then report back.
LOTD_Exp_Quest11	|Quest Giver: - Professor Patero Marassi (or Auryen if Marassi has died), after Branching Out and No One Escapes Cidhna Mine.\nLocation: - East of the crossroads north of Rorikstead (the Reach).\nOverview: - Build the Western Field Station from 100 lumber, 40 stone blocks and 20 slabs of clay, or leave it to Marassi or Auryen and give them a few days to build it.
LOTD_Exp_Quest12	|Quest Giver: - Professor Patero Marassi (or Auryen if Marassi has died), after Branching Out... Again.\nLocation: - West of Fort Amol, at the crossroads between the Rift, Eastmarch and Whiterun.\nOverview: - Pay 2000 gold for the Jarl's tax, then gather 100 lumber, 40 stone blocks and 20 slabs of clay and build the Eastern Field Station.
LOTD_Exp_Quest13	|Quest Giver: - Latoria, after she has joined the Explorers Society.\nLocation: - Explorers Society Guildhouse (Solitude).\nOverview: - Bring Latoria any ruined books you find, give her a day to decipher them and come back to see what she has discovered. Repeatable.\nNOTE: This quest will reward you with a random treasure map, book or spell scrolls.
LOTD_Exp_Quest14	|Quest Giver: - Automatic, when Schneider's Sextant or the Locate Relic power finds a relic nearby.\nLocation: - The location you are in.\nOverview: - Your research says this place holds a relic. Explore it completely to find it. Repeatable.
LOTD_Exp_Quest15	|Quest Giver: - Auryen Morellus, from time to time after An Interesting Prospect.\nLocation: - Dragonborn Gallery (Solitude).\nOverview: - A buyer has ordered three artefacts. Reconstruct them at an archaeology station (or hand the job to an Explorers Society member and check back with Auryen the next day), then return them to Auryen for a share of the sale. Repeatable.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Legacy of the Dragonborn: journals
----------------------------------------------------------------------------
LOTD_Journals_Quest00	|Quest Giver: - Read Sanamia's Journal, Vol. 1, found aboard the Dev Aveza.\nLocation: - Mzulft (Eastmarch).\nOverview: - Sanamia wrote of a hidden chamber in the storeroom of Mzulft. Dig your way into it and claim what is inside.\nNOTE: Access to the Dev Aveza is needed.
LOTD_Journals_Quest01	|Quest Giver: - Read Sanamia's Journal, Vol. 2, found in Broken Tusk Mine (Solstheim).\nLocation: - Valthume (Hjaalmarch).\nOverview: - Sanamia visited Valthume to honour the dead and found several chambers collapsed. Clear the rubble and search what lies behind it.\nNOTE: Access to Solstheim is needed.
LOTD_Journals_Quest02	|Quest Giver: - Read Sanamia's Journal, Vol. 3, found at Dead Drop Falls.\nLocation: - Fort Frostmoth (Solstheim).\nOverview: - Sanamia describes digging in the once-wealthy Fort Frostmoth. Clear the rubble to reach a well-stocked storeroom.\nNOTE: Access to Solstheim is needed to finish it.
LOTD_Journals_Quest03	|Quest Giver: - Read Sanamia's Journal, Vol. 4, found in Arcwind Point.\nLocation: - Lake Ilinalta (Falkreath Hold).\nOverview: - Find the sunken ruin at the bottom of Lake Ilinalta and clear the rubble blocking its doorway.
LOTD_Journals_Quest04	|Quest Giver: - Read Sanamia's Journal, Vol. 5, found in Thirsk Mead Hall (Solstheim).\nLocation: - A circle of standing stones around a burial site.\nOverview: - Sanamia found a ring of standing stones around some rubble. Dig there to unearth a sarcophagus full of riches.\nNOTE: Access to Solstheim is needed.
LOTD_Journals_Quest05	|Quest Giver: - Read Sanamia's Journal, Vol. 6, found at a Riekling camp in northern Solstheim.\nLocation: - Moves around Skyrim.\nOverview: - Sanamia mentions a chest that teleports itself from place to place. Keep an eye out for it; touching it makes it vanish and teaches you a new spell.\nNOTE: Access to Solstheim is needed.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Legacy of the Dragonborn: notes
----------------------------------------------------------------------------
LOTD_Notes_Quest00	|Quest Giver: - Read Auryen's Notes on Symmachus, in the museum.\nLocation: - Saering's Watch (Solstheim).\nOverview: - Auryen thinks the Dagger of Symmachus is held by a ritualist on Solstheim. Find it on the altar at Saering's Watch.\nNOTE: If you already picked up the Dagger of Symmachus before reading the note, the quest finishes instantly with a different journal entry. Access to Solstheim is needed.
LOTD_Notes_Quest01	|Quest Giver: - Read Auryen's Notes on Cyrus' Saber, in the museum.\nLocation: - The wreck of the Brinehammer.\nOverview: - Auryen has traced the sword of Cyrus to the ship Brinehammer. Search the wreck to find the blade.\nNOTE: If you already picked up Cyrus' Saber before reading the note, the quest finishes instantly with a different journal entry.
LOTD_Notes_Quest02	|Quest Giver: - Read Auryen's Notes on Orgnum and the Maormer, in the museum.\nLocation: - Valthume (Hjaalmarch).\nOverview: - Auryen believes King Orgnum's Coffer was hidden with a dragon priest. Recover it from Valthume.\nNOTE: If you already picked up King Orgnum's Coffer before reading the note, the quest finishes instantly with a different journal entry.
LOTD_Notes_Quest03	|Quest Giver: - Read Auryen's Notes on the Ice Blade of the Monarch, in the museum.\nLocation: - Skyrim.\nOverview: - Track down the Ice Blade of the Monarch and take it from King Olaf One-Eye.\nNOTE: If you already picked up the Ice Blade of the Monarch before reading the note, the quest finishes instantly with a different journal entry.
LOTD_Notes_Quest04	|Quest Giver: - Read Auryen's Notes on Shalidor's Stone, in the museum.\nLocation: - Labyrinthian (Hjaalmarch).\nOverview: - Find Shalidor's Stone at the centre of Shalidor's maze in Labyrinthian.\nNOTE: If you already picked up Shalidor's Stone before reading the note, the quest finishes instantly with a different journal entry.
LOTD_Notes_Quest05	|Quest Giver: - Read Auryen's Notes on the Bloodworm Helm, in the museum.\nLocation: - Skyrim.\nOverview: - Auryen thinks the Bloodworm Helm of Mannimarco is with necromancers. Kill the leader of the coven trying to raise the Wolf Queen and take the helm.\nNOTE: If you already picked up the Bloodworm Helm before reading the note, the quest finishes instantly with a different journal entry.
LOTD_Notes_Quest06	|Quest Giver: - Read Auryen's Notes on the Warlock's Ring, in the museum.\nLocation: - A Silver Hand hideout.\nOverview: - Auryen suspects the Silver Hand have the Warlock's Ring. Find it in one of their hideouts.\nNOTE: If you already picked up the Warlock's Ring before reading the note, the quest finishes instantly with a different journal entry.
LOTD_Notes_Quest07	|Quest Giver: - Read Auryen's Notes on the Dragonbone Cuirass, in the museum.\nLocation: - Highpoint Tower (Solstheim).\nOverview: - The Dragonmail Cuirass may be held by a Telvanni wizard. Find it deep inside Highpoint Tower, guarded by a former student of Neloth.\nNOTE: If you already picked up the Dragonmail Cuirass before reading the note, the quest finishes instantly with a different journal entry. Access to Solstheim is needed.
LOTD_Notes_Quest08	|Quest Giver: - Read Auryen's Notes on the Fists of Randagulf, in the museum.\nLocation: - Blue Palace (Solitude).\nOverview: - The Fists of Randagulf have been in Solitude all along. Get them from the Blue Palace by paying the steward, persuading him or stealing them.\nNOTE: Either steal the gloves from the master-locked display in the corridor to the left of the throne room or bribe or persuade Falk Firebeard to let you have the gloves.
LOTD_Notes_Quest09	|Quest Giver: - Read Auryen's Notes on the Tools of Kagrenac, in the museum.\nLocation: - The wreck of the Pride of Tel Vos and Raven Rock (Solstheim), and Skyrim.\nOverview: - Recover the three Tools of Kagrenac: Sunder from a safe aboard the wreck of the Pride of Tel Vos, Wraithguard from the Hlaalu agents in Raven Rock and Keening from Arniel.\nNOTE: If you already picked up Sunder, Wraithguard and Keening before reading the note, the quest finishes instantly with a different journal entry. Access to Solstheim is needed.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Legacy of the Dragonborn: miscellaneous
----------------------------------------------------------------------------
LOTD_Misc_Quest00	|Quest Giver: - Automatic, when you find the secret passage under the floor of the Dragonborn Hall.\nLocation: - Dragonborn Gallery (Solitude).\nOverview: - Explore the dusty hidden room under the Dragonborn Hall and ask Auryen about it. He lets you use it as the Hall of Secrets, a private display space for relics of a more questionable nature.
LOTD_Misc_Quest01	|Quest Giver: - Calcelmo, by letter, after The Lost Expedition.\nLocation: - Understone Keep (Markarth); leads to the Temple of Xrib below the Sightless Pit, Alftand and Irkngthand.\nOverview: - Calcelmo wants help researching Falmer artefacts found in Dwemer ruins. Read his notes and follow three leads: Xrib (through Freir at the Temple of the Divines in Solitude), Alftand (through Urag gro-Shub and a missing book taken by a Synod mage) and Irkngthand (past its sealed doors, with the help of a Snow Elf ghost). Bring all three Snow Elf staves back to Calcelmo.\nNOTE: This quest has 3 paths to take; it is recommended to do them in order to avoid backtracking.
LOTD_Misc_Quest02	|Quest Giver: - Greigor, at the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary.\nLocation: - Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary, the Glacial Cave (Solstheim) and Solitude.\nOverview: - Greigor has carried the Hand of Glory for most of his life and wants to pass it on. Find the Hanged Man's Hand and Roggvir's Essence, make the candle at his cooking pot, show him the finished Hand of Glory, then grant his wish and send him to the Night Mother.\nMissable: - The quest fails if Greigor dies before it is done, for example if you destroy the Dark Brotherhood.\nNOTE: If you decide to destroy the Dark Brotherhood, you must be careful to not kill everyone inside before finishing the quest.
LOTD_Misc_Quest03	|Quest Giver: - Automatic, when you read Greigor's Journal, after The Hand of Glory.\nLocation: - Solitude (Ahtar) or the Explorers Society Guildhouse (Eriana).\nOverview: - The Hand of Glory's curse can be broken by killing Ahtar, or you can give the Hand to Eriana of the Explorers Society, who agrees to take on the curse and its boons.
LOTD_Misc_Quest04	|Quest Giver: - Ongar Brewer.\nLocation: - Nightgate Inn (the Pale).\nOverview: - Ongar will trade his oddly enchanted warhammer, Kegbreaker, for a good replacement. Forge or find a warhammer, give it to him, then show Kegbreaker to Auryen, who finds it is Sanguine's artefact the Inebriator. If Ongar dies first, you can still claim the hammer.
LOTD_Misc_Quest05	|Quest Giver: - Automatic, when you find the plans for the spider imbuing machine in White Ridge Barrow.\nLocation: - White Ridge Barrow, then the Safehouse in the museum.\nOverview: - Gather 5 Charcoal, 6 Iron Fittings, 3 chunks of Glass, 2 Iron Hinges and 10 Iron Ingots, then build a replica of the imbuing machine in the Safehouse workshop.\nNOTE: Access to the Safehouse is needed.
LOTD_Misc_Quest06	|Quest Giver: - Read the Writ of Execution at the Penitus Oculatus Outpost.\nLocation: - Steepfall Burrow (northern coast of Skyrim).\nOverview: - The Penitus Oculatus are hunting a renegade legionnaire, Praefect Torbal, who has the Lord's Mail. Find him in Steepfall Burrow, already killed by their agents, read the bloody note on his body and reach the other part of the cave from the cliffside to claim the armour.\nNOTE: Lord's Mail is needed for another quest.
LOTD_Misc_Quest07	|Quest Giver: - Read 'Lost Wonders of the Ages Vol. 3', find the remains of a stranded Knight of the Nine, or pick up one of the relics.\nLocation: - Across Skyrim.\nOverview: - Reunite the relics of the Divine Crusader, Pelinal Whitestrake: the helm, armour, boots, gauntlets, mace, shield and sword of the Crusader, along with the Ring of Sir Amiel.\nNOTE: This quest can also be started by finding any of the artefacts, although it is recommended to start this quest by reading the book.
